filter-date-range-invalid: Xicpehpena melahuac tonaltin; tlamiliztonalli ma yeto san se ica pehualiztonalli o zatepan.
filter-due-any: Zazo catli tlamiliztonalli (noihqui tlen amo quipiah)
filter-due-previous-week: Monequi tlamiz ipan chicomeilhuitl tlen opanoc
filter-due-next-month: Monequi tlamiz ipan metztli tlen huallauh
filter-column-age-disabled: Amo xiquintlatia ica quezqui cahuitl catcah ipan tocatlahtolli
filter-column-age-hint: Xiquintlatia amatlapaltin tlen ocalacqueh ipan inin tocatlahtolli ocachi inin quezqui tonaltin achto. Occequih tocatlahtoltin huan amatlapaltin tlen amo momati in incalactonalli noihqui monextiah. Ipatlaliz amatlapalli amo occeppa quipehualtia icahuitl ipan tocatlahtolli.
filter-on-desc: Tiquinchipahua amatlapaltin ipan inin huapalli. Xictoca nican inic ticpatlas tlachipahualiztli.
advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Xicpehpena amatlapaltin intonal ica @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt o @listEnteredAt. Neixcuitilli: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' o @endAt = none. Xictlali itoca in tlac tlen timochihuilia huan pehua ica @ inepantla comillas.
advanced-filter-description: Hueyi tlachipahualiztli mitzcahuilia xictlahcuilo ce tlahtolli tlen quipia inin tequitiltin: == != <= >= && || ( ) Ce cahcahualli quinxeloa tequitiltin. Huel tiquinchipahuas mochi monemac tlaltin ica intocayo ihuan impatiuh. Machiyotl: Field1 == Value1. Tlanonotzaliztli: Intla tlaltin noso patiuhtin quipiah cahcahualli, xiquintzacuati ica zan ce tlahtolmachiyotl. Machiyotl: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Inic ticpanos zan ce tlanahuatilmachiotl (' \/), huel tictequihuis \. Machiyotl: Field1 == I\'m. Noihqui huel ticnelos miyac tlamantli. Machiyotl: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Mochipa mochi tequitiltin mocaquih itech opochtli hasta yecma. Huel ticpatlas tlatecpanaliztli ica tiquintlalis tlatzacuatin. Machiyotl: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Noihqui huel tictemos tlahtoltlaltin ica regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i
text-contains-trigger-description: Monelhuayōtia ihcuac ce tlahcuilōlmachiyōtl mochīhua, ahnozo tocaitl ahnozo tlahtōltēnyōtl mocuepa, īhuān yancuīc tlahtōlli quipiya inin (ahmo motta huēyi ahnozo tepitōn tlahcuilōlli).
imported-member-no-account: Tlacatl calaquic — ayamo onca tlacatequitilamatl namictih
impersonate-emergency: Niman calaquiliztli: xiquinmachiti mochintin occequintin tepachoanimeh axcan
email-emergency-access-text:
__admin__ oquitequitilti niman calaquiliztli inic calaquiz quemeh __user__ itech __url__ ipan __time__.

Ica: __note__

Nochi tlen omochiuh ipan inon cah ipan Tepachoani ihuapal / Tlacah / Tlatemoliztli amatl ihuan Tlahtlacoltin / Tlacatl ixiptlaliztli tlanonotzaliztli.
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Xicpepecho ce Kanboard tlaquixtilli JSON: ce tlamantli ica "columns" (noso tequitl ica column_name) ihuan ce "tasks" tlatecpanalli (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Columns mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan tasks mocuepah amatlapaltin.
import-board-instruction-deck: Xicpepecho ce NextCloud Deck huapalli JSON (ce huapalli ica "stacks", sesen stack quipia "cards"). Stacks mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan cards mocuepah amatlapaltin.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Xicpepecho ce OpenProject work-packages nechicoliztli JSON (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Statuses mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan work packages mocuepah amatlapaltin.
import-board-instruction-issues: Xicpepecho ce __sourceName__ ahcuallotl JSON tlatecpanalli (__endpoint__). Ahcuallotin mocuepah amatlapaltin tlatecpanaltin ipan Open / Closed tocatlahtoltin.
import-board-instruction-asana: Xicpepecho ce Asana tequitl tlaquixtilli JSON ({ "data": [...] } itech Asana tlaquixtilli noso GET /tasks). Tequitl monechicoa ipan secciones (memberships); tequitl tlamic yauh Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Xicpepecho ce ZenKit tocatlahtolli tlaquixtilli JSON ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan items mocuepah amatlapaltin.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Xitlali ce markdown tequitl tlanechicolli (in nescayotl tlen tequitl markdown-kanban iuhqui Obsidian Kanban quitequitiltia): "## Tlanechicolli itoca" tlahtolpani, ihuan "- [ ]"/"- [x]" tlamantli tlatzintlan. Tlahtolpani mocuepa tlanechicolli ihuan tlamantli mocuepa amamachiotl.
import-board-instruction-leo: Xicpepecho in Leo tlatecpanaliztli (.leo tlahcuilolli). In tlamantli tlacpac cateh mocuepah tocatlahtolli, in impilhuan mocuepah amatlapalli, ihuan in tlamantli itlahcuilol mochihua amatlapalli itlahtol. In tlamantli oc achi tlatzintlan cateh mocuepah tlaixnamiquiliztli tocatlahtolli. In tlamantli machiyotia motlaliah iuhquin ye otlanqueh.
import-board-instruction-opml: Xictlali ce OPML tlanextiliztli, quen quiquixtiah Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq ihuan occequintin. Achtopa tlamantli mocuepah tocatlahtoltin, inpilhuan mocuepah amatlapaltin ica tlahcuilolli quen tlahtolli, ihuan tlamantli tlen oc temo mocuepah tlanextiliztocatlahtoltin. Tlamantli tlamiltin mocalaquiah quen otlan.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Xictlali ce Org mode tlanamactli, quen quitlahcuiloah Emacs, Orgzly noso Beorg. Achtopa tzontecomatl mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan ic ome tzontecomatl mocuepah amatlapaltin. TODO ihuan DONE, achtopayotl, machiotl, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE ihuan CLOSED mopiah, ihuan tlamachiotiloni ihuan tzontecomatl tlen oc temo mocuepah tlanextiliztocatlahtoltin.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Xicpepecho ce todo.txt amatlahcuilolli: ce tequitl ipan ce tlaxotlalli, iuhquih quihcuiloa in todo.txt tepoztequitl ihuan occequintin tlen ihuan huel tequitih. Tequitl tlen otlan ("x") yauh "Otlan", +project ihuan @context mocuepah machiyotl, (A) mocuepa machiyotl tlen achto monequi, ihuan due: ihuan t: mocuepah tonalli tlen tlamiz ihuan pehuaz.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Xicpepecho in tlein quiza ipan task export: ce JSON tlahuipantli, nozo ce tequitl ipan cece tlahuipantli. In tequitl tlamitoc yahui ipan Done; project ihuan priority mochihua machiotl, annotations mochihua tlahtolpehualiztin, ihuan depends quimotitia in tequitl tlein quitzacua occe tequitl.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Xictlapo in .boardarchive amatl ihuan xicpepecho in huapalli board.jsonl, ica nozo amo ica in versión itlahuipan. In huapalli itlachiyaliz in tlein quinechicoa mochihua tocatlahtoltin; occe tlamantli tlein huel ticpehpena mochihua machiotl. In tlahcuilolli ihuan in nauhcampa tlein ticmachiotia imaxelol mochihua tlahtolli ihuan tlaixnamiquiliztli tocatlahtolli; tlahtolpehualiztin mocahuilia. Ixiptlahuan ihuan amatl tlein motlalilia amo calaqui.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-azuredevops: Ipan Azure DevOps, xictlapo Boards, niman Queries, xicchihua ce tlatlaniliztli tlen quinextia in tlacuilolpanitl tlen ticnequi, ihuan xicpehpena Export to CSV; niman xicpehpena inon amatl .csv. In Board Column (nozo State) mochihuah tocatlahtoltin ihuan Board Lane ohtin; in tequitl mochihuah amatlapaltin ica intlamantiliz ihuan tags quemeh machiotl, Assigned To, tonalli, tlanextiliztli ihuan intahtzin, ihuan occequin tlacuilolpanitl mochihuah monemac tlalli.
import-board-instruction-mslists: Ipan Microsoft Lists, xictlapo in tocatlahtolli, xicpehpena Export, niman Export to CSV, ihuan xicpehpena inon amatl .csv. In tlacuilolpanitl Status (nozo Progress) mochihua tocatlahtoltin ihuan cecen tlamantli ce amatlapalli, ica itoca, itlanextiliz, tlacameh, tonalli ihuan tags; occequin tlacuilolpanitl mochihuah monemac tlalli.
import-board-instruction-msproject: Ipan Microsoft Project, xicpehpena File, niman Save As, ica in tlamantiliztli XML Format (*.xml), ihuan xicpehpena inon amatl. In huehuei tequitl mochihuah ohtin ihuan in tequitl mochihuah amatlapaltin ipan Not started, In progress nozo Completed, ica intonal, intlahcuilol, intlatquih, intequitonhuan ihuan tlen achtopa.
import-board-instruction-outlook: Ipan Outlook, xicmaxtla in amatlahcuilolli ipan ce amatlatlaliloyan ipan motepozmachiyo, nozo xicpia ica File, niman Save As, quemeh Outlook Message Format (*.msg). Xicpehpena ce amatl .msg, nozo ce .zip ica amatl .msg ihuan .eml. Cecen tlahtolli mochihua ce amatlapalli ipan Board View / Email, ica itlananquililhuan quemeh tlahtolpehualiztin ihuan itlatzonhuan quemeh amatl.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Ipan MeisterTask, xictlacui tequiyotl itocayo, xicpehpena Export project ihuan xicquixti CSV, satepan xictlali. Xeloliztli mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan tequitl mocuepah amatlapaltin, ica intlahcuilol, tlamiliztonalli, tlanahuatilli ihuan machiotl; tequitl tlamiltin quipiah intlamiliztonal. Ce CSV tlahcuilolli para MeisterTask icalaquiliz no tequiti.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Ipan Obsidian, xictlapo Kanban huapalli itlanamac quen Markdown (noso xictlapo .md tlanamactli ipan ce tlahcuilolpatlaloni), satepan xictlali mochi. Ohtin mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ica inamatlapalhuan itlamiliz, amatlapaltin quipiah inmachiohuan, tonalli, achtopayotl, tlaltin ihuan tlanextiliztocatlahtolli, ihuan Archive mocuepa amatlapaltin ipan pixcalli.
import-board-instruction-linear: Ipan Linear, xiquinquixti tlahtlaniliztli quen CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, noso ce tlachializtli iquixtiliz), satepan xictlali CSV. Nemiliztli mocuepah tocatlahtoltin, tlanechicolli mocuepah ohtin, ihuan tlahtlaniliztli mocuepah amatlapaltin ica intlanahuatil, machiotl, tonalli, tetahtzin tlahtlaniliztli, achtopayotl, tlatemachiliztli, tequiyotl ihuan cuepaliztli.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Ipan TickTick, xictlapo Settings, Account, Backup & Import ihuan xicchihua ce tlapializtli, satepan xictlali CSV tlanamactli. Sesen TickTick tocatlahtolli mocuepa ohtli ihuan itlaquetzalhuan mocuepah tocatlahtoltin; tequitl quipiah inmachiohuan, tonalli, tlanextiliztocatlahtolli, achtopayotl ihuan tequitontli.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Ipan ClickUp, xiquinquixti tequitl quen CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, noso ce List noso Table tlachializtli iquixtiliz ica nochtin tlaquetzalli), satepan xictlali CSV. Nemiliztli mocuepah tocatlahtoltin, ClickUp tocatlahtoltin mocuepah ohtin, ihuan tequitl mocuepah amatlapaltin ica intequitonhuan, tlanahuatiltin, machiotl, tonalli, achtopayotl ihuan cahuitl.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Ipan Nullboard, xictlapo huapalli, xicpehpena Export this board... ipan tlaahxitiliztli, xictlapo .nbx tlanamactli ipan ce tlahcuilolpatlaloni ihuan xictlali tlen quipia. Tocatlahtoltin mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan tlahcuilolli mocuepah amatlapaltin: ce tlahcuilolli iachtopa tlahcuilolpan yez amatlapalli itocayo ihuan occe yez itlahtol. Ce tlahcuilolli raw quiselia machiotl raw. Ce tlanamactli ica miec huapaltin quicalaquia iachtopa huapal.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Ipan Kanri, xictlapo Import & Export ihuan xicpehpena Export individual board (noso Export all data), satepan xictlali .json tlanamactli. Tlaquetzalli mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan amatlapaltin mocuepah amatlapaltin, ica intlahtol, tlamiliztonalli, machiotl ihuan tlapalli; ce amatlapalli itequiuh mocuepa tlanextiliztocatlahtolli. Ipan ce nochi tlapializtli iquixtiliz mocalaquia achtopa huapalli.
import-board-instruction-planka: Xicmachiyotlali in ichan mo Planka (quemeh https://planka.example.com), mo tequitini itoca ihuan mo ichtaca tlahtolli ipan Planka, zatepan xicpachoa «Xicnextili tlen huelitiz calaquiz». Zan ic motequitiltia ic mocui in amatl ihuan amo mopixtoc. Xicpehpena ce amatl ihuan xicpachoa «Xiccui»: WeKan quipoa ipan in API ica Planka ica itocatlahtolhuan, iamatlapalhuan, itlanextiliz, itonal tlamiliz, imachiohuan, itlacamehuan, itequitocatlahtolhuan ihuan itlahtolhuan, zatepan xicchihua in calaquiliztli quemeh mochipa. In amatlapalli ipan pixcalli ica Planka calaquih quemeh opixqui; in tlen tzonilpitoc ihuan in amatlapalli ipan tlazolcomitl amo calaquih.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: Ipan Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), xicalaqui, xictlacaquiti in tlahuelitiliztli Tasks.Read ihuan xiccopina in token ipan Access token. Xicpilo nican ihuan xicpachoa «Xicnextili tlen huelitiz calaquiz»; in token zan ic inin tlacuiliztli motequitiltia ihuan amo mopixtoc. Xicpehpena mochi tocatlahtolli nozo ce ihuan xicpachoa «Xiccui». Cecen tocatlahtolli To Do mochihua tocatlahtolli ihuan cecen tequitl ce amatlapalli, ica itlahcuilolhuan, itonal tlamiliz ihuan peuhyan, ipasohuan quemeh tlaixnamiquiliztli tocatlahtolli, itlamantihuan quemeh machiotl, huei tlamachiliztli ihuan quenin icaca quemeh machiotl; in tequitl tlen otlan mopixtoc. In tlaelnamiquiliztli ihuan tlacuepaliztli amo calaquih.
import-board-instruction-onenote: Ipan Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), xicalaqui, xictlacaquiti in tlahuelitiliztli Notes.Read ihuan xiccopina in token ipan Access token. Xicpilo nican ihuan xicpachoa «Xicnextili tlen huelitiz calaquiz»; in token zan ic inin tlacuiliztli motequitiltia ihuan amo mopixtoc. Xicpehpena ce amoxtli ihuan xicpachoa «Xiccui». In xelolli mochihuah tocatlahtoltin ihuan in amaixtli mochihuah amatlapaltin, ica intlahcuilol, in caxitl tlen tequitl quemeh tlaixnamiquiliztli tocatlahtolli ihuan in amaixtontli quemeh tequitontin.
import-board-instruction-teams: Xicpilo ce token Microsoft Graph ica Chat.Read (ipan Graph Explorer, ce cuentah tequitl nozo calmecac) ihuan xicpachoa «Xicnextili tlen huelitiz calaquiz», niman xicpehpena ce tlahtolli nozo ce apantli ihuan xicpachoa «Xiccui»; in token amo mopixtoc. Nozo xicpehpena ce amatl: in .tar ipan motlaquixtiliz ipan teams.live.com/dataexport, nozo ce .json ica tlahtolamatl. Cecen tlahtolli mochihua ce amatlapalli ipan Board View / Chat, ihuan itlahtolhuan in tlahtolpehualiztin.
import-board-instruction-sandstorm: Ipan Sandstorm, xictlapo in grain __app__, xiquixpepena "Download backup" ipan icpac tlatlapalli in grain, ihuan xiquixpepena inon .zip amatl. Tlen oncah ipan grain mochihua huapalli, itlamantiyohuan mochihuah amatlapaltin ihuan tlen in tequiamatl quipia ipampa. Xiquixpepena in tequiamatl ic yez in grain: in grain occe tequiamatl ahmo moceliya, ihuan quihtoa catlehuatl tequiamatl.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: Ipan KanbanFlow, xictlapo in menu ica amatl, xicpehpena Settings → API & Webhooks ihuan xiccopina in API token ica amatl. Xicpilo in token nican, xicpachoa «Xicnextili tlen huelitiz calaquiz», xicpehpena in amatl ihuan xicpachoa «Xiccui»; in token zan ic on tlacuiliztli motequitiltia ihuan amo mopixtoc. In tlaquetzalli mochihuah tocatlahtolli ihuan in ohtli mocahuah ohtli; in tequitl quipiah itlanextiliz, itlapal, imachiohuan, itonal tlamiliz, itequipilhuan quemeh tlaixnamiquiliztli tocatlahtolli, in cahuitl tlen motequitilti, in tlapohualli, in tlacameh ihuan in tlahtolli.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Xicmachiyotlali in ID ica mo Basecamp (in tlapohualli zatepan basecamp.com/ ipan ichan) ihuan ce token ic calaquiz (ica ce app OAuth 2 tlen omotlalih ipan launchpad.37signals.com, nozo tlen ye quipia ce tlanahuatilli), xicpachoa «Xicnextili tlen huelitiz calaquiz», xicpehpena ce tlachihualli ihuan xicpachoa «Xiccui». In token zan ic on tlacuiliztli motequitiltia ihuan amo mopixtoc. Cecen amatlapalli tlapepechtli mochihua ohtli ica itlaquetzalhuan quemeh tocatlahtolli, ihuan in tocatlahtolli tlen monequi mochihuaz mochihuah ohtli «To-dos»; in amatlapalli quipiah itlahcuilol, itonalhuan, tlacameh ihuan tlahtolli, in ipasohuan ce amatlapalli mochihuah tlaixnamiquiliztli tocatlahtolli, ihuan tlen otlan mopixtoc.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Xiccui ce token ic calaquiz ipan OAuth 2.0 Playground: tlatzintlan Tasks API v1 xicpehpena tasks.readonly, xicpachoa Authorize APIs, zatepan Exchange authorization code for tokens, ihuan xiccopina in token. Xicpilo nican ihuan xicpachoa «Xicnextili tlen huelitiz calaquiz», xicpehpena mochi tequitocatlahtolli nozo ce, zatepan «Xiccui». In token zan ic inin tlacuiliztli motequitiltia ihuan amo mopixtoc. In tequitocatlahtolli mochihuah tocatlahtolli ihuan in tequitl mochihuah amatlapalli, ica itlahcuilolhuan, itlazalolhuan ihuan itonal tlamiliz; in tequipilli mochihuah tlaixnamiquiliztli tocatlahtolli ihuan in tequitl tlen otlan calaquih quemeh opixqui.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: In API ica Google Keep zan ic Google Workspace. Xiccui ce token OAuth 2.0 ica https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (ipan OAuth 2.0 Playground intla mo tlayacanqui Workspace quicahua, nozo ica ce tequipanoliztli ID ica nochi domain), xicpilo, xicpachoa «Xicnextili tlen huelitiz calaquiz» zatepan «Xiccui». In token zan ic inin tlacuiliztli motequitiltia ihuan amo mopixtoc. In tlahcuilolli mochihuah amatlapalli ipan tocatlahtolli «Notes», ihuan in tlahcuilolli ica tlaixnamiquiliztli mochihuah amatlapalli ipan tocatlahtolli «Lists» ica itlamanhuan quemeh tlaixnamiquiliztli tocatlahtolli. In tlahcuilolli ipan tlazolcomitl, in tlen tzonilpitoc ihuan in tlamamaliztli amo calaquih.
api-import-desc: Xiccui ipan in tequipanoliztli ica mo ID. Tlen nican ticmachiyotlalia zan ic inin tlacuiliztli motequitiltia ihuan amo mopixtoc.
api-import-fetched: Omocuic. Xiquitta in tlacameh tlatzintlan ihuan xiccalaqui.
api-import-nothing: Amo onca tlen calaquiz ica inin cuenta.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Ipan Pivotal Tracker, xictlapo tequiyotl iMORE tlaxeloliz ihuan xicpehpena Export CSV (noso xiquinpehpena tlaquetzaliztli ihuan xicpehpena Bulk Actions, CSV), satepan xictlali CSV. Sesen tlaquetzaliztli inemiliz mocuepa tocatlahtolli ihuan tlaquetzaliztli mocuepah amatlapaltin, ica innemiliz ihuan machiotl, tecuhtin, tetlahtlaniani, tonalli, tlahtolpehualiztli, tequitl ihuan tlatzacuiliztli; Estimate mocuepa Story points ihuan cuepaliztli mocuepah sprints.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Ipan Tasks.org, xictlapo Settings, Backups ihuan xicpehpena Export tasks, satepan xictlali tlen quipia inon .json tlanamactli. Tocatlahtoltin mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan tequitl mocuepah amatlapaltin, ica intlahcuilol, machiotl, tonalli, tlahtolpehualiztli ihuan tequitontli; tequitl tlamiltin quipiah intlamiliztonal, ihuan achtopayotl mocuepa monemac tlalli.
import-board-instruction-monday: Ipan monday.com, xictlapo huapalli itlaahxitiliz, xicpehpena More actions ihuan Export board to Excel (ica yancuiliztli ihuan tlamantontli intla ticnequi), satepan xicpehpena inon .xlsx tlanamactli. Status tlaquetzalli mocuepa tocatlahtoltin ihuan nechicoliztli mocuepah ohtin; tlacah, tonalli, tonalcuepohualli ihuan machiotl quipiah inyeyan, occequintin tlaquetzalli mocuepah monemac tlaltin ihuan yancuiliztli mocuepah tlahtolpehualiztli.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Ipan Super Productivity, xictlapo Settings, satepan Sync & Backup, xicpehpena Export Data ihuan xictlali tlen quipia sp-backup .json tlanamactli. Sesen tequiyotl mocuepa ohtli ihuan tequitl mocuepah amatlapaltin ipan To Do, In Progress, Backlog noso Done, ica intlahcuilol, machiotl, tlamiliztonalli, cahuitl tlen opanoc ihuan tequitontli; tequitl ipan pixcalli mocuepah amatlapaltin ipan pixcalli.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Ipan Taiga, xictlapo Admin > Project > Export ihuan xictemohui tequiyotl itlapializ (achtopa xictlapo ce .json.gz tlanamactli), satepan xictlali iJSON. User story nemiliztli mocuepah tocatlahtoltin, user stories mocuepah amatlapaltin ica intequiuh quen tequitontli, epics ihuan tlahtlaniliztli quipiah inohhuan, ihuan sprints, machiotl, tlahtolpehualiztli ihuan monemac tlamantli no huallauh. Tlanamictilli amo mocalaquiah.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Ipan Vikunja, xictlapo Settings, xicpehpena Data Export ihuan xictemohui .zip tlanamactli tlen mitztitlania, satepan xicpehpena inon tlanamactli, noso xictlali data.json tlen quipia. Kanban caxitl mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan tequitl mocuepah amatlapaltin, ica inmachiohuan, tlanahuatiltin, tonalli, tlahtolli, tequitl itocatlahtol quen tlanextiliztocatlahtoltin ihuan tlahtolpehualiztli; achtopayotl, quezqui ipan ciento otlan ihuan otlan mocuepah monemac tlaltin. Tlanamictilli amo mocalaquiah.
import-board-instruction-quire: Ipan Quire, xictlapo tequiyotl itlaahxitiliz ihuan xicpehpena Export CSV, satepan xictlali CSV. Nemiliztli mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan tequitl mocuepah amatlapaltin, ica intequitonhuan quen amatlapalpipiltin, tlanahuatiltin, machiotl, pehualiztonalli, tlamiliztonalli ihuan tlantzontonalli, tlahtolli ihuan achtopayotl quen monemac tlalli. Tlahtolpehualiztli ihuan tlanamictilli amo cateh ipan Quire iCSV.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Ipan Wrike, xicquixti ce tequiyotl noso amatlatlatiloni ipan Excel, noso xictemiti Wrike iExcel icalaquiliz neixcuitilli, satepan xicpehpena inon .xlsx tlanamactli. Amatlatlatiloni ihuan tequiyotl tlahcuilolpan mocuepah ohtin, Status mocuepa tocatlahtoltin ihuan tequitl mocuepah amatlapaltin, ica inKey, tetahtzin tequitl, tlanahuatiltin, pehualiztonalli ihuan tlantzontonalli, netechpanoliztli ihuan tlahtolli; Priority, Duration ihuan occequintin tlaquetzalli mocuepah monemac tlaltin.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Ipan Teamwork.com, xictemiti Excel tequitl icalaquiliz neixcuitilli (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) ihuan xicpiya quen .xlsx, satepan xicpehpena inon tlanamactli. Tequitl itocatlahtol mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan tequitl mocuepah amatlapaltin; ce tequitl tlen pehua ica -, # noso > mocuepa itequiton tequitl tlen icpac ca (--, ## noso >> ce tlamantli oc temo). Tlanahuatiltin, tonalli ihuan machiotl quipiah inyeyan; Priority, Estimated time ihuan Complete mocuepah monemac tlaltin.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Ipan Businessmap (achtopa Kanbanize), xictlapo Advanced Search, xicpehpena Configure results ic tiquinpehpenaz tlaquetzalli, xictemohui Excel tlanamactli, satepan xicpehpena inon .xlsx tlanamactli. Tlaquetzalli mopohuah ica intocayo ipan inglés (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): intla motequiuh quitequihuia occe tlahtolli, achtopa xicpatla tzontecomatl tlahcuilolpan ipan inglés. Column mocuepa tocatlahtoltin ihuan Lane ohtin; tecuhtin, machiotl, tlapalli, tonalli, tlahtolpehualiztli ihuan tetahtzin ilpiliztli quipiah inyeyan, ihuan Priority, Size, Type ihuan occequintin tlaquetzalli mocuepah monemac tlaltin.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Ipan Redmine, xictlapo tequiyotl iIssues, xicpehpena Also available in: CSV itzintlan tocatlahtolli, xiquinpehpena tlaquetzalli (All columns, ica Description) ihuan xicquixti, satepan xictlali CSV. Redmine quintocayotia tlaquetzalli ipan motlahtol, ic xictlali motlahtol ipan inglés ipan My account achtopa ticquixtiz. Sesen nemiliztli mocuepa tocatlahtolli ihuan tlahtlaniliztli mocuepah amatlapaltin, ica tracker quen machiotl, tlanahuatilli, tlachiuhqui, tonalli, tetahtzin tequitl ihuan tlahtlaniliztli tlen monetechpanoah; achtopayotl, tlamantli, tlaneltoquilli tlapatlaliztli, cahuitl tlatemachilli, % Done ihuan monemac tlaltin mocuepah monemac tlaltin.
import-board-instruction-notion: Ipan Notion, xictlapo tlapializtli quen ce nochi amatl, xicpehpena ••• ihuan Export, xicpehpena Markdown & CSV, ihuan xicpehpena .zip tlanamactli tlen motemohuia, noso ce tlapializtli CSV tlen itech quiza, noso xictlali inon CSV. Ce tlaquetzalli itocayo Status mocuepa tocatlahtoltin (intla amo onca, iachtopa tlaquetzalli tlen monextia quen tlapehpenaliztli, ihuan icalaquiliz tlanonotzaliztli quihtoa catlehhuatl); tlahcuilolpan mocuepah amatlapaltin ica intocayo, machiotl, tlacah quen tlacah ipan amatlapalli, tonalli, ihuan amatl itlahcuilol quen tlahtolli; occequintin tlaquetzalli mocuepah monemac tlaltin. Netechpanoliztli, tlachialoni ihuan tlanamictilli amo mocalaquiah.
import-board-instruction-plane: Ipan Plane, xictlapo Workspace Settings, xicpehpena Exports, xiquinquixti tequiyotl quen JSON, CSV noso Excel ihuan xictemohui .zip tlanamactli, satepan xicpehpena inon tlanamactli, noso ce tlanamactli tlen itech ca, noso xictlali JSON noso CSV. Nemiliztli mocuepah tocatlahtoltin, tequiyotl mocuepah ohtin, ihuan tlahtlaniliztli mocuepah amatlapaltin ica inmachiyo, tetahtzin, tlanahuatiltin, machiotl, tonalli, ilpiliztli ihuan tlahtolpehualiztli; achtopayotl, tlatemachiliztli, cuepaliztli ihuan module mocuepah monemac tlaltin. Plane iquixtiliz amo quipia tlahtolli noso tlanamictilli, ic amo mocalaquiah.
import-board-instruction-fizzy: Ipan Fizzy, xicquixti in cuenta ipan "Account settings", nozo moamatlapaltin ica "Download my data", ihuan xiquixpepena in .zip amatl tlen Fizzy mitzhualmihua, nozo in .json amatl ce amatlapalli. In huapaltin mochihuah ohtin ihuan in tlaquetzalli mochihuah tocatlahtoltin, ica "Maybe?", "Not now" ihuan "Done" quen ipan Fizzy; in amatlapaltin quipiyah intlahtol, inmachiotl, intlanahuatilli, intlamantli quen tlaixnamiquiliztli tocatlahtolli, intlahtolpehualiztin ihuan inamauh.
import-board-instruction-mail: Xiquixpepena ce .mbox amatl, in iuhqui quipiya Thunderbird, Apple Mail, mutt nozo Gmail ica Google Takeout, nozo ce .eml tlahtolli, nozo xiquicuilo itlahtol. Cecen nohnotzaliztli mochihua ce amatlapalli ipan Inbox tocatlahtolli, ica aquin oquititlan, aquin oquiceli ihuan itocah, inic monextia ipan Email tlachiyaliztli; in tlanankiliztin mochihuah itlahtolpehualiztin. In Gmail machiotl mochihuah machiotl. In tlanamictilli amo calaquiah.
import-board-instruction-ical: Xiquixpepena ce .ics tonalamatl amatl, in iuhqui quiquixtiah Google Calendar, Apple Calendar nozo Reminders, Thunderbird, Nextcloud nozo Outlook, nozo xiquicuilo itlahtol. In tequitl yauh To Do, In Progress, Done nozo Cancelled iuhqui ieliz, ihuan in ilhuitl yauh Events, ica itlapehualiztonal ihuan itlamiliztonal, inic monextiah ipan Calendar ihuan Gantt tlachiyaliztin. In tlamantli ihuan in achtopa mochihuah machiotl. In tlen mocuepa ceppa calaqui.
import-board-instruction-googletakeout: Ipan takeout.google.com, xiquixpepena Tasks, Keep, Mail, Calendar ihuan Google Chat, xicchihua in quixtiliztli ihuan xictemohui in .zip amatl, niman nican xiquixpepena. Cecen tlamantli mochihua ce ohtli: amatlahcuilolli ic Email tlachiyaliztli, tequitl tocatlahtolli ihuan tlahcuilolli ica intlaixnamiquiliztli tocatlahtolli, tonalamatl ilhuitl ihuan tequitl ica tonalli, ihuan nohnotzaliztli calli tlen intlahtol tlahtolpehualiztin ic Chat tlachiyaliztli. Occequi tlamantli ihuan tlanamictilli amo calaquiah.
import-board-instruction-slack: Ipan Slack, xictlapo in workspace tlahtlaliliztli, xiquixpepena Import/Export Data, xicquixti in workspace ihuan xictemohui in .zip amatl, niman nican xiquixpepena. Cecen apantli mochihua ce amatlapalli ipan Channels, Groups nozo Direct messages, ihuan itlahtol ihuan in thread tlanankiliztin mochihuah itlahtolpehualiztin in amatlapalli, iuhqui aquin oquicuilo, inic in Chat tlachiyaliztli quinextia in apantli. In amatl amo calaquiah.
import-board-instruction-mattermost: Xicquixti ica mmctl export create, xictemohui in quixtiliztli ihuan xiquixpepena in .jsonl amatl, nozo xiquicuilo itlahtol. Cecen apantli ihuan cecen tlahtolli ixtlamatcayotl mochihua ce amatlapalli, ihuan itlahcuilol ihuan itlanankiliz mochihuah itlahtolpehualiztin in amatlapalli, inic in Chat tlachiyaliztli quinextia in apantli. In teams mochihuah ohtli. In amatl amo calaquiah.
import-board-instruction-telegram: Ipan Telegram Desktop, xictlapo Settings, Advanced, Export Telegram data, xiquixpepena in JSON iyeliz ihuan xicquixti, niman xiquixpepena in result.json amatl, nozo xiquicuilo itlahtol. Cecen nohnotzaliztli mochihua ce amatlapalli ipan Direct messages, Groups nozo Channels, ihuan itlahtol mochihuah itlahtolpehualiztin in amatlapalli, inic in Chat tlachiyaliztli quinextia in nohnotzaliztli. In ixiptlayotl ihuan in amatl amo calaquiah.
import-board-instruction-whatsapp: Ipan WhatsApp, xictlapo in nohnotzaliztli, xiquixpepena Export chat ahmo ica media, ihuan nican xiquixpepena in .txt amatl, nozo xiquicuilo itlahtol. In nohnotzaliztli mochihua ce amatlapalli tlen itlahtol itlahtolpehualiztin, iuhqui aquin oquititlan ihuan quemman, inic in Chat tlachiyaliztli quinextia. In media ihuan in sistema tlahtolli amo calaquiah.
import-board-instruction-discord: Xicquixti ce Discord apantli ica DiscordChatExporter ipan JSON iyeliz ihuan xiquixpepena in .json amatl, nozo xiquicuilo itlahtol. In apantli mochihua ce amatlapalli ipan itlamantli, ihuan itlahtol mochihuah itlahtolpehualiztin in amatlapalli, inic in Chat tlachiyaliztli quinextia in apantli. In tepantli mochihua in ohtli. In tlanamictilli amo calaquiah.
import-board-instruction-rocketchat: Ipan Rocket.Chat, xicquixti motlamatiliz quen JSON ipan "My Data" ihuan xiquixpepena in .zip amatl tlen mitzhualmihua, nozo in .json amatl tlen oquixtiloc ce calli. Cecen calli mochihua ce amatlapalli ihuan itlahtol mochihuah itlahtolpehualiztin in amatlapalli, inic in Chat tlachiyaliztli quinextia in calli. No mopohua in .zip tlen WeKan quiquixtia ic in CSV tlacalaquiliztli ipan Rocket.Chat.
import-board-instruction-evernote: Ipan Evernote, xicquixti in tlahcuilolli nozo ce amoxtli quemeh .enex amatl ihuan nican xiquixpepena, nozo xiquicuilo itlahtol. Cecen tlahcuilolli mochihua ce amatlapalli ica itlahtol, itequitl caxtin quemeh tlaixnamiquiliztli tocatlahtolli, imachiotl quemeh machiotl ihuan itlalnamiquiliz quemeh tlamiliztonalli; in tlahcuilolli tlen itlalnamiquiliz ye omochiuh yauh Done. In ixiptlayotl ihuan in tlanamictilli amatl amo calaquiah.
import-board-instruction-trello: Ipan moTrello huapalli, xiyauh 'Menu', niman 'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', ihuan xiccopina tlahtolli monextic.
import-board-instruction-csv: Xicpepecho moComma Separated Values (CSV) / Tab Separated Values (TSV).
import-board-instruction-jira: Xicpepecho JSON itech Jira Cloud REST API ahcuallotl temoliztli (GET /rest/api/3/search/jql), noso ce namictih { "issues": [...] } tlamantli. Jira statuses mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan issues mocuepah amatlapaltin. Huel ticaquitis ce "automationRules" tlatecpanalli inic tiquincalaquis nahuatiltin.
import-board-instruction-excel: Xicpehpena ce WeKan-machiyotl .xlsx tlapoualtlacuilolli (san se columnas quemeh Excel tlaquixtilli: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, dates, custom fields). Achto fila cah tlacpac tocayotl.
import-board-instruction-wekan: Ipan mohuapalli, xiyauh 'Menu', niman 'Export board', ihuan xiccopina tlahtolli ipan archivo temohuiloc.
import-board-instruction-about-errors: Intla tiquittaz ahcuallotin ihcuac ticcalaquia huapalli, quemman calaquiliztli tequiti ihuan huapalli cah ipan Nochi Huapaltin amatl.
import-members-mode-map: Xicpehpena ce tequitini tlen ye onca para sesen yehhuantin
import-members-mode-placeholder: Xiquinpiya quen tequitinimeh tlaixiptlayotl ica intocayo, ic satepan tiquinnamictiz ica nelli tequitinimeh
csv-mapping-description: Xicpehpena tlanamactli itlaquetzal tlen quipia sesen amatlapalli itlal. Tlapehpenaliztli ochihualoc ica tlaquetzalli intocayo; xicpatla tlen amo melahuac, ihuan xicpehpena (amo ipan tlanamactli) para ce tlalli tlen tlanamactli amo quipia.
csv-mapping-list-missing: Tlanamactli amo quipia tlaquetzalli para tocatlahtolli. Xicpehpena ce icpac, noso xictlahcuilo itocayo inon san ce tocatlahtolli campa calaquiz nochi amatlapalli.
csv-mapping-custom-fields: Occequintin tlaquetzalli ic mocalaquizqueh quen tlahtolli monemac tlaltin:
csv-mapping-title-required: Xicpehpena tlaquetzalli tlen quipia amatlapaltin intocayo.
csv-mapping-list-required: Xictlahcuilo itocayo tocatlahtolli campa calaquiz nochi amatlapalli, noso xicpehpena tlaquetzalli tlen quipia tocatlahtolli.
invalid-import-mapping: Tlaquetzalli inamictiliz amo monamiqui ica tlanamactli.
import-many-boards-hint: Xiquinpehpena miec iquixtiliz tlanamactli inin tepoztli, noso ce .zip tlen quinpia: sesen tlanamactli mocuepa ihuapal, mocalaquia amo ica tlacah inamictiliz. Ce .zip tlen yehhuatl ce iquixtiliz (Vikunja, Notion, Plane, noso WeKan ica tlanamictilli) ce huapalli. Ihcuac tlanamactli mopehpenah nican, Import quincalaquia ipan itlalpan tlalli tlen icpac ca.
import-one-board-per-project-hint: Sesen ohtli tlen icalaquiliz quichihuazquia (ce tequiyotl, amatlatlatiloni noso tocatlahtolli inin tepoztli) mocuepa ihuapal. Tetahtzin amatlapaltin ihuan netechpanoliztli itzalan inon huapaltin monextiah ipan icalaquiliz tlanonotzaliztli.
export-all-boards-hint: Nochtin huapaltin tlen huel tiquinquixtiz, ipan ce temohuiliztli: Excel quen ce amoxtli ica ce amatl sesen huapalli ica itocayo, nochi occe tlahcuilolmachiyotl quen ce .zip ica ce tlanamactli sesen huapalli.
import-json-file: Noso xicpehpena ce Trello JSON archivo
import-attachments-zip: Trello tlanamictiltin ZIP (huel amo, itech Trello Card Attachments Downloader)
import-trello-json-file-hint: Ce Trello huapalli tlaquixtilli quemeh .json. Intla oticpix Trello API key ihuan token, itemalhuan, huapalli icuitlapan ihuan tlacah ixnescayo noihqui motemohuiah.
import-trello-zip-file-hint: Ce .zip ica ce noso miyac huapalli .json archivos ihuan intlanamictilhuan ipan huapalli-tocayotl carpetas (itech Trello Card Attachments Downloader). Mochi huapaltin mocalaquiah.
import-trello-zip-no-boards: Amo monextih Trello huapalli .json archivos ipan .zip.
import-timeout: Calaquiliztli cenca ohuehcahuac ihuan omotzacuac. Xicyehyeco occepa; intla oc mochihua, huapalli huel cenca hueyi noso tlanextilcalco huel tequiti.
import-too-large: Amatlacuilolli cenca hueyi inic cen calaquiz. Xiquixelo ipan amatlacuilolli tepitzin, quemeh ica tequitl noso ica tonalli, ihuan xiccalaqui cecentetl.
import-trello-zip-too-many-files: .zip quipia cenca miyac archivos inic mocalaquis.
import-trello-zip-file-too-large: Ce archivo iitic .zip cenca hueyi inic mocalaquis.
import-trello-zip-unsafe-path: .zip quipia archivos imochoh amo cualli ihuan amo oseliloc.
import-attachment-auth-hint: In tlaquixtiliztli quintocaitia itlanamictilhuan, zan amo quinhuica in amatl. Inic quinhuicaz, xictlali in itlacuilol in tequitl ihuan in calaquiliztli: zan ipampa inin calaquiliztli motequiuhtia, zan oncan motitlani, ihuan aic mopia. Xiccahua ahtle inic tiquincalaquiz ahmo amatl.
import-attachment-auth-token: API tlanexcayotl, API tlatzacuilli noso ichtaca tlahtolli app
import-trello-workspace-placeholder: Huapalli calaquic motlalia itzintlan inin tequitiloyan, mochihua intla amo onca
trello-api-import: Xiccalaqui melahuac itech Trello ica API key ihuan token
trello-api-import-desc: Xicpepecho moTrello API key ihuan token inic tiquintlatecpanas moTrello tequitiloyan ihuan huapaltin, niman xiquincalaqui tlaixpehpenaltin ica intlanamictilhuan.
trello-api-token: Trello API token (monehmatcah mochihua itzintlan API key)
trello-api-credentials-required: Xiccaqui Trello API key ihuan token nochi ome.
trello-api-credentials-saved: Trello API key ihuan token opixqueh. Huel tiquintlatecpanas tequitiloyan amo tiquincalaquis occepa.
trello-export-desc: Xicchihua ce copinaliztli inin huapalli ipan Trello ica Trello iAPI, ica moTrello API key ihuan token. Ohtin mocuepah machiotl itocayo "Swimlane: …", tlen WeKan iTrello icalaquiliz quincuepa ohtin.
sandstorm-trello-access-needed: Ce Sandstorm grain amo quipia Internet icalaquiliz. Achtopa xicmaca inin grain ma ahsi Trello.
sandstorm-trello-save-label: Trello, para tlacalaquiliztli ihuan tlaquixtiliztli huapaltin
trello-select-boards: Xicpehpena ce huapalli noso ocachi inic ticcalaquis.
trello-cancel-delete-confirm: ¿Xicahua calaquiliztli ihuan xiquinpolo huapaltin tlen inin tequitl ya oquincalaqui? Amo huel mocuepas.
import-members-map: Mohuapalli calaquic quipia cequintin tlacah. Xiquinnamicti tlacah tlen ticnequi tiquincalaquis ica motlacahuan
import-members-map-note: Tlanonotzaliztli: Tlacah amo namictih monahuatizqueh itech axcan tlacatl.
import-user-select: Xicpehpena motlacatl onca tlen ticnequi tictequihuis quemeh inin tlacatl
invalid-year: Xihuitl amo cualli. Xictlahcuilo mochi nahui tlapoualtin, machiyotl 2026.
shared-labels-desc: Inin machiotl nican mopiya hueliz motequitiltiz ipan miac huapaltin, ihuan in machiotl in ce huapalli. Intla nican tiquimpatla itoca anozo itlapal, mopatla ipan nochtin huapaltin tlen quitequitiltia; intla tiquipolohua, mocahua ipan inon huapaltin quemin inmachiouh.
label-delete-pop: Amo huel mocuepas. Inin quiquixtiz inin machiotl ipan mochi amatlapaltin ihuan quipolos inemiliz.
last-admin-desc: Amo huel ticpatlas tequiuh pampa monequi onca ce tlayecani noso ocachi.
hide-board: Xiquiza inin huapalli: xictlati ipan Nochtin huapaltin. Motlacatepan noso monecentlaliliz mocahua, ihuan Tlacatl tlaahxitiliztli / Tlatlatilli huapaltin quicuepa.
group-members-read-only: Zan itlayecanihuan inin tlacamecayotl huel quipatlazque aquin onca itech. Ce tlacamecayotl tlen huitz LDAP noso occe amoxcalli ompa mopatla, amo ipan WeKan.
leave-board-pop: ¿Tictemaca tiquizas ipan __boardTitle__? Timocuiliz ipan mochi amatlapaltin ipan inin huapalli.
list-archive-cards: Xiquinuica mochi amatlapaltin ipan inin tocatlahtolli pixcalco
list-archive-cards-pop: Inin quinquixtiz mochi amatlapaltin ipan inin tocatlahtolli itech huapalli. Inic tiquittaz amatlapaltin ipan pixcalli ihuan tiquincuepas ipan huapalli, xictoca “Menu” > “Pixcalli”.
list-move-cards: Xiquinuica mochi amatlapaltin ipan inin tocatlahtolli
list-select-cards: Xiquinpehpena mochi amatlapaltin ipan inin tocatlahtolli
list-delete-pop: Mochi tlachihualtin mopolosqueh ipan tequitiliztli ihuan amo huel ticuepas tocatlahtolli. Amo huel mocuepas.
list-delete-suggest-archive: Huel ticuicas ce tocatlahtolli pixcalco inic ticquixtis ipan huapalli ihuan ticpias tequitiliztli.
log-out-everywhere-confirm: Inin mitzquixtia ipan ce ce tlachiyaloni, tepozteca ihuan tequipanoni campa otimocalaqui, ihuan nican no.
passkeys-description: Ce calaquiliztli tlatzacuilolli mitzcahua ximocalaqui ica inin tepoztli imahpil itlachihual, ixayac, itzacualiz noso itlapiyaliz tlatzacuilolli ipan ichtaca tlahtolli. Mocahua ipan motepoz; WeKan zan quipia inahuatil tlatzacuilolli.
passkey-add: Xicaquiti ce calaquiliztli tlatzacuilolli ipan inin tepoztli
passkeys-unsupported: Inin tlachiyaloni amo huel quichihua calaquiliztli tlatzacuiloltin.
passkey-invalid: Amo huel omotequitilti inon calaquiliztli tlatzacuilolli.
passkey-sign-in-failed: Amo oquichiuh calaquiliztli ica calaquiliztli tlatzacuilolli. Occeppa xicyeyeco, noso ximocalaqui occe ica.
passkey-too-many: Ticpia achi miac calaquiliztli tlatzacuiloltin tlen huel quipia ce cuenta. Achtohui xicquixti ce.
passkey-needs-https: Calaquiliztli tlatzacuiloltin quinequi WeKan ipan ce https:// tlacaliliztli.
moveCardPopup-leave-link-at-origin: Xikkāhua se tlahsalol kan ohuia achto
muted-info: Ayic ticceliz tenahuatiliztli ica patlaliztli ipan inin huapalli
name: Tocaitl
normal-desc: Huel quitta ihuan quipatla amatlapaltin. Amo huel quipatla tlaahxitiliztli.
normal-assigned-only-desc: Zan amatlapaltin tlanahuatiltin monextiah. Quipatla quemeh melahuac tlacatl.
notify-participate: Xicseli yancuic tlahtolli ipan mochi amatlapaltin campa titequiti quemeh tlachihuani noso tlacatl
notify-watch: Xicseli yancuic tlahtolli ipan huapaltin, tocatlahtoltin noso amatlapaltin tlen tiquintlachilia
page-maybe-private: Inin amatl huel ichtacayotl. Huel tiquittaz intla ticalaquiz.

r-wrike-workflow-note: Ce Wrike itequiohhui ce tocatlahtolli nemiliztli, sesen ipan Active, Completed, Deferred noso Cancelled nechicoliztli. Tlaquixtiliztli quitlahcuiloa inin huapalli itocatlahtolhuan quen ce, ica huapalli itocayo, ipan JSON tlen Wrike iAPI quicuepa para tequiohhuitl: xicchihua inon tequiohhuitl ipan Wrike achtopa ticcalaquiz huapalli iWrike Excel iquixtiliz, ic itlanemiliz motlaliz. Tlacalaquiliztli quipohua inon JSON tlatlalilli icpac, itech WeKan noso itech Wrike iGET /workflows, ipan huapalli tlapehpenalli: ce nemiliztli amo ica tocatlahtolli mocuepa tocatlahtolli, ihuan ce nahuatilli quimachiotia ce amatlapalli quen otlan ihcuac mocuica ipan ce Completed noso Cancelled nemiliztli ihuan amo otlan ipan ce Active noso Deferred. Wrike inahuatil amo huel moquixtiah itech Wrike.

submit-on-enter-description: Ihcuac motlapoa, Enter quipia amatlapalli itocayo, itlahtol ihuan occequintin tlahtolpatlanih; Shift+Enter quicaquitia yancuic pantli. Ihcuac motzacua, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter quipia ihuan Enter quicaquitia yancuic pantli.
keep-title-tags: Xicpiya #machiotl ihuan @tlacatl ipan yancuic amatlapalli tzontecomatl
keep-title-tags-description: Ihcuac tiquixpepena ce machiotl ica # noso ce tlacatl ica @ ihcuac tiquihcuiloa in itzontecon ce yancuic amatlapalli, nopa tlahcuilolli mocahua noihqui ipan tzontecomatl. Tlacahualli: in tlahcuilolli mopatla ica in machiotl noso in tlacatl.
title-bracket-label: Xicpatla [machiotl] ipan ipehualiz yancuic amatlapalli tzontecomatl ic machiotl
title-bracket-label-description: Ihcuac in yancuic amatlapalli tzontecomatl pehua ica [Tlahcuilolli] auh quitoca occequi tlahcuilolli, in Tlahcuilolli mochihua ce machiotl in amatlapalli (mochihua intla in huapalli amo quipia machiotl ica inon tocaitl) auh mocui ipan tzontecomatl. Tlacahualli: in tzontecomatl mocahua quen ca.
keep-add-card-form-open: Ma tlapohtoc mocahua in amatl ic xicaquiti amatlapalli in ihcuac oticaquih ce amatlapalli
keep-add-card-form-open-description: Tlapohtoc: in ihcuac omocaquih ce amatlapalli, in amatl mocahua tlapohtoc ica ce cactoc tocaitl ic occe amatlapalli. Tzauctoc: in amatl motzacua in ihcuac omocaquih in amatlapalli.
checklist-ding-sound: Xitzotzona tlacaquiztli ihcuac checklist tlamantli tlamiya
checklist-ding-sound-description: Quitzotzona ce tlacaquiztli tepitzin ihcuac ticmachiotia ce checklist tlamantli. Cehcentetl amo tlatzacuilia.
notification-settings-popup-description: Xictlali quenin tlahtoltin tictlazohtlaz. Tlanahuatiliztli: Tlanahuatiani Tlapechtli, zatepan Tlapechtli patlaliztli, zatepan mohuaxca patlaliztli itech Tlapohuani tlanahuatilli.
notification-activity-description: Xicquixti in machiotl itech ce tlamantli tlen mochihua ipan amatlapalli, inic ayacmo ticceliz tlanahuatilli ipan coyolli ihuan ica tlahcuilolli. In tlanahuatilli tlen mitzilnamiquiltia in tonalli tlamiliztli ihuan in motoca tlen motenehua ica @ nochipa ahci.
ntfy-description: Xiquinceli motlanahuatil ipan moteléfono ica in ntfy app. Ximocalaqui ipan ce tlahtolli ipan in app, ihuan xictlali nican in tlahtolli ichan, quen https://ntfy.sh/a-long-secret-name. Aquin quimati itocah ce tlahtolli nochtlacatl huel quipohua, ic xicchihua huehueyac ihuan ichtacayotl, nozo xicchihua motlatqui ntfy servidor ica ce token ic calaquiz.
ntfy-invalid-topic-url: In tlahtolli ichan monequi quen https://ntfy.sh/my-topic.
ntfy-invalid-token: In token ic calaquiz quipia tlahcuilolmachiyotl tlen ahmo mocahua.
web-push: Tlanahuatilli tlen tlachiyaliztli ipan inin tepoztli
web-push-description: Xicselili motlanahuatilhuan WeKan ipan inin tlachiyaliztli manel WeKan tzactoc. Xictlati ipan nochi tlachiyaliztli huan tepoztli campa ticnequi.
web-push-denied: Tlachiyaliztli amo quicahua tlanahuatilli ipan inin tlalli. Xiccahua ipan itlatecpanaliz tlachiyaliztli, zatepan occeppa xicyeyeco.
web-push-failed: Amo huelitic omopatlaque nican tlanahuatilli tlen tlachiyaliztli.
notification-activity-created: Amatlapalli, tocatlahtolli ihuan ohtli tlen mochihua
due-reminder-days-label: Xitlanahuati ipan inin tonaltin, xicxeloh in tlapohualtin ica machiotl ",": 0 yehuatl in tonalli tlamiliztli, in tlapohualtin tlen panoh 0 quitoznequi in tonaltin achto inon tonalli, ihuan in tlapohualtin tlen amo ahci 0 quitoznequi in tonaltin zatepan inon tonalli. Xiccahua cactoc inic tictequihuiz in servidor itlanahuatil achtopa.
due-reminder-off: Amo onca ilnamiquiliztli itech tonalli tlamiliztli ipan inin huapalli
due-reminder-webhook: Noihqui xictitlani in ilnamiquiliztli itech tonalli tlamiliztli itech webhook tlen quititlani tlanahuatilli quiyahuac inin huapalli
due-reminder-invalid: Xictequihui tlapohualtin tlen tzoncah, pehua -14 ihuan ahci 14, itech tonaltin; amo ma pano mahtlactli tonaltin.
due-reminder-saved: In ilnamiquiliztli itech tonalli tlamiliztli omotlatih.
roles-info: Xiquinpehpena tlen huapalli tequiuhtin huel quichihuah sesen tlachihualiztli. Tlayecanaliztli tlacah (hueyi tlayecanqueh) mochipa quipiah mochi cahuiliztin ihuan amo huel quintzacuah nican.
roles-status-desc: Tlein sesen huapalli tequiuh huel quichihua. Zan tlapoualiztli: quimati cuadros tlacpac, yeca quitta tlen oticpehpen achto ticpias.
custom-roles-desc: Xicchihua ce tequitl ica tlen huelis quichihuas ce huapalli tlacatl, ihuan xicmaca tlacameh quemeh ce tequitl ye onca. Huapalli tlayecani mocahua quemeh ce tequitl ye onca.
delete-linked-card-before-this-card: Amo huel ticpolos inin amatlapalli achto ticpolos amatlapalli tlailpilli tlen quipia
delete-linked-cards-before-this-list: Amo huel ticpolos inin tocatlahtolli achto tiquinpolos amatlapaltin tlailpiltin tlen quinmanah amatlapaltin ipan inin tocatlahtolli
drag-template-here-to-share: Xicuilana ce neixcuitilli huapalli nican inic ticxelos
remove-domain-from-board: ¿Tictemaca ticquixtis inin tlalnemachiyotl ipan inin huapalli?
invalid-domain: Tlalnemachiyotl amo cualli. Xictequihui ce tlalnemachiyotl quemeh example.com (amo @ noso cahcahualli).
shared-templates-info: Xiquitta tlacah inneixcuitilhuapaltin tlen huel moxeloh, tlatecpanaltin ica nechicoliztli, tlanechicolli noso tlahcuilolnemachiyotl itlalnemachiyo. Xicpehpena ce noso ocachi tlaxelolli tlatzintlan inic tiquinnextis neixcuitiltin namictih. Zan tlacah aquin inneixcuitilhuapalli amo cacahuac monextiah.
shared-templates-select-scope: Xicpehpena ce tlaxelolli tlacpac (Nechicoliztin, Tlanechicollin noso Tlalnemachiyotin) inic tiquinnextis neixcuitiltin tlateilhuicah.
autoAddUsersWithDomainName: Xiquincaquiti tlacah ica tlalnemachiyotl itocayo ica huelitiliztli
board-table-card-title-wrap-on: In tocaitl amoxtli mopatla miak tlamantli. Xitlatzitzquili para xiquitzquican ica yeyi puntoh.
board-table-card-title-wrap-off: In tocaitl amoxtli motequipano ica yeyi puntoh. Xitlatzitzquili para mopatla miak tlamantli.
board-table-group-by-swimlane-on: Amoxtin mosentlalia ica ohtli. Xitlatzitzquili para quitta kemej se tlahtolli tlapetlanki.
board-table-group-by-swimlane-off: Amoxtin motta kemej se tlahtolli tlapetlanki. Xitlatzitzquili para mosentlalia ica ohtli.
dueCardsViewChange-choice-all-descriptio: Quinnextia mochi amatlapaltin amo tlamic ica *Tlamiliztonalli* itech huapaltin campa tlacatl quipia cahuiliztli.
globalSearchViewChange-choice-all-descri: Xiquintemo mochi amatlapaltin ipan huapaltin campa ticpia cahuiliztli. Xicpehpena *Noamatlapalhuan* inic ticnepantlalis tlananquiliztin ipan amatlapaltin campa titlacatl noso titlanahuatilli.
dueCards-noResults-description: Axcan amo ticpia amatlapaltin ica tlamiliztonaltin.
comment-not-found: Amatlapalli ica tlahtolpehualiztli tlen quipia tlahtolli '%s' amo monexti.
operator-limit-invalid: %s amo ce cualli nepantlaliztli. Nepantlaliztli monequi ce positivo tlapoualli.
globalSearch-instructions-description: Temoliztin huel quipiah tequitiltin inic ocachi melahuac temoliztli. Tequitiltin motlahcuiloah ica itocayo ihuan ipatiuh moxeloh ica colon. Machiyotl, `list:Blocked` quinepantlalis temoliztli ipan amatlapaltin tlen oncateh ipan ce tocatlahtolli itocayo *Blocked*. Intla ipatiuh quipia cahcahualli noso iyoca machiyotl, monequi motzacua ica tlahtolmachiyotl (machiyotl `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - amatlapaltin tlen quipiah ce machiotl namictih ica *<color>* noso *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - amatlapaltin ipan ce huapalli tlanahuatilli ipan nechicoliztli *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - amatlapaltin ipan ce huapalli tlanahuatilli ipan tlanechicolli *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - amatlapaltin tlen tlamizqueh ipan *<n>* tonaltin itech axcan. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ quinnextia mochi amatlapaltin tlen ya opanoc intlamiliztonal.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - amatlapaltin tlachihualtin ipan *<n>* tonaltin noso achi
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - amatlapaltin patlaltin ipan *<n>* tonaltin noso achi
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - mochi amatlapaltin pixcalco ihuan amo pixcalco
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - campa *<field>* cah ce itech `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` noso `__predicate_member__`. Xiclalili `-` iixpan *<field>* inic tictemos amo oncayotl ipan inon tlalli (machiyotl `has:-due` quitemoa amatlapaltin amo tlamiliztonalli).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - campa *<sort-name>* cah ce itech `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` noso `__predicate_modified__`. Inic tictecpanas temoc, xiclalili `-` iixpan tlatecpanaliztocayotl.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - campa *<n>* cah ce positivo tlapoualli tlen quimati amatlapaltin tlapoualli tlanextililo ipan sesen amatl.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Tequitiltin san se monepanoah ica *OR*. Amatlapaltin namictih ica ce tlamantli mocuepah.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` quincuepaz amatlapaltin ipan ce tocatlahtolli itocayo *Blocked* noso *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Tequitiltin iyoca monepanoah ica *AND*. Zan amatlapaltin namictih ica mochi iyoca tlamantli mocuepah. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` quincuepa zan amatlapaltin ipan tocatlahtolli *Available* ica machiotl *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Tonaltin huel motlaliah quemeh positivo noso negativo tlapoualli, noso ica `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` noso `__predicate_year__` para axcan cahuitl.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Tlahtol temoliztin amo quixeloah hueyi ihuan tzinco tlahtolli.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Ica tlachihualmachiyotl, amatlapaltin pixcalco amo motemoah.
dependencies-open-a-board: Xictlapo ce huapalli inic tiquincalaquiz noso tiquinquixtiz itlalpilizhuan.
dependencies-board-edit-required: Zan in aquique intequiuh quincahuilia quipatla noso quiolini in amatlapalli huel quincalaquia in huapalli itlalpilizhuan.
import-dependencies-merged: Omopihui __imported__ pantli; __skipped__ ye onca, __unmatched__ amo monamictia
dependency-layer-mine: Zan tehuatl huel tiquitta inin tlalpiliztli
dependency-read-only: Motequiuh amo mitzcahuilia tiquinpatla in huapalli itlalpilizhuan
drag-to-connect: Xicuilana inic ticnamictis ica occe amatlapalli
import-dependencies-placeholder: Noso xicpepecho tlaneltoquiliztin JSON / SVG nican
import-dependencies-empty: Xicpehpena ce huapalli ihuan xictemaca ce tlaneltoquiliztli pantli noso ocachi
location-detect-from-map: Xictemo canin ipan ce mapatl tlanamictilli
location-detect-none: Amo huelic mopantiz canin ipan inin tlanamictilli.
location-detect-done: Tlanextilli canin ahcic motemitih in tlanahuatiltin tlatzintlan.
server-error-troubleshooting:
Timitztlatlauhtia xictitlani in tlahtlacolli oquichih in teposcalli.
Ipan snap tlahtlaliliztli, xictequiti: `sudo snap logs wekan.wekan`
Ipan Docker tlahtlaliliztli, xictequiti: `sudo docker logs wekan-app`
custom-field-stringtemplate-context-hint: Xictequiti %{card.title}, %{board.title}, %{list.title} anozo %{swimlane.title}. Xictlali |urlencode ipan machiyotl ipatca tlen huel mopatla, ic tictitlaniz ipan URL, iuhquin %{value|urlencode}.

filename-invisible-legend: Chichiltic: tlanamactli itoca quipia ahmo nezqui tlahcuiloltin
login-refused-bad-password-fix: Ahtle monequi mocualtlaliz intla ahmo occeppa mochihua: in tlacatl huel quiyancuiliz itlaichtaca tlahtol, ahnozo ce tlayacanqui huel quitlaliz yancuic ipan Tlacah.
login-refused-unknown-user: Ahmo onca amatlahcuilolli ica inon tequitini itoca ahnozo tlahcuilolli
login-refused-unknown-user-fix: Xiquitta catlehhuatl tocaitl quitequiuhtia in tlacatl; xicnotza ahnozo xicchihua amatlahcuilolli ipan Tlacah.
login-refused-account-disabled-fix: Xictlapo in amatlahcuilolli ipan Tlacah, intla monequi huel calaquiz.
login-refused-braked-fix: Ihcuac ticmati aquin, xictlapo ipan Tlacah / Tzacualloqueh tlacame.
login-refused-malformed-credentials-fix: Mochipa ce script ahnozo ce huehcauh tlatequitiltilli; xiquitta calaquiliztli tlatecpanaliztli ipan Tlacah / Calaquiliztli.
login-refused-ldap-bad-credentials: In tocaamatl (LDAP) ahmo oquiceli in tequitini itoca ahnozo ichtaca tlahtolli
login-refused-ldap-bad-credentials-fix: Xiquitta LDAP tlatecpanaliztli ipan Tlacah / LDAP, ihuan intla in tlacatl onca ipan tocaamatl.
login-refused-ldap-not-in-allowed-group: Ahmo itech in tocaamatl necentlaliliztli tlen huel quitequiuhtia WeKan
login-refused-ldap-not-in-allowed-group-: Xiccalaqui in tlacatl ipan inon necentlaliliztli ipan tocaamatl, ahnozo xicpatla in necentlaliliztli tlachaquanilli ipan Tlacah / LDAP.
login-refused-ldap-account-not-linked: Ce WeKan amatlahcuilolli ica inon tocaitl ahmo motlalcuitlapilhuia ica tocaamatl
login-refused-ldap-account-not-linked-fi: Xictlali LDAP_MERGE_EXISTING_USERS=true ic mohuiltequiz ipan occe calaquiliztli, ipan Tlacah / LDAP.
login-refused-ldap-bound-to-another-entr: In amatlahcuilolli tlen monamiqui ipan occe tlahcuilolli in tocaamatl
Xiquitta ipan Tlacah catlehhuatl tocaamatl tlahcuilolli itech pohui in amatlahcuilolli: ce calaquiliztli tocaitl occeppa motequiuhtia ahmo quitlapoz occe tlacatl iamatlahcuilol.
office-report-desc: Canin calaquih tlacame, monextia cece tlacatl. Cece IPv4 noso IPv6 tlalnemachiyotl quinextia in tlalli, altepetl ihuan quexquich cuali calaquiliztli huel monextia.
office-no-results: Ayac ocalaquic oc, noso ayac calaquiliztli omopix.
api-report-desc: Catliyehuatl REST API calaquiloyan motequitia, aquin ihuan quexquichpa. Ce pantli cece tlapohualiztli ihuan calaquiloyan, ica in cahuitl quipia; ahmo ce pantli cece tlatlaniliztli.
api-no-calls: Amo omopix REST API tlatlaniliztli. API amo tequiti intla ahmo WITH_API=true.
recovery-report-desc: Tequitl momatqui ic tlamachiyotl mocahuaz ihuan mocualtiliz: tlahtlacolli temoliztli, tlahtolli tlapiyaliztli, cuepaliztli, occepa calaquiliztli itech MongoDB ihuan hueyi tlahtolpixcalli momatqui mocualtilia.
recovery-no-events: Amo omopix cuepaliztli tlamochihualiztli. Tlahtolpixcalli cualtinemi.
recovery-maintenance-note: Ximochiya; inin amatl isel mocuepaz ihcuac tlamiz cuepaliztli.
delete-org-warning-message: Amo hueli mopoloz inin nechicoliztli, ica onca ce tlacatl itech pohui
delete-team-warning-message: Amo hueli mopoloz inin tlanechicolli, ica onca ce tlacatl itech pohui

filter-preset-replace-hint: Zan motech pohui ipan inin huapalli. Intla ticpiya ica zan no itoca, yancuic quipatla achto tlen catca.
filter-preset-error: Amo ohuelic mopiyaz anozo motequihuiz inin tlaixpehpenaliztli. Xiquitta itoca, tlaixpehpenaliztli itlahtol ihuan motecahuiliz huapalli ic ticcalaquiz.

newlineBecomesNewChecklistItem: Cece yancuic pantli tlahtolli mochihua ce tlanextiliztocatlahtolli tlamantli
