blockly-MATH_ONLIST_TOOLTIP_RANDOM: Xiccuepa ce tlamantli zan quenin itech tocatlahtolli.
blockly-MATH_ONLIST_TOOLTIP_SUM: Xiccuepa inechicol nochi tlapoualli ipan tocatlahtolli.
blockly-MATH_RANDOM_FLOAT_TOOLTIP: Xiccuepa ce tlaxelolli zan quenin itzalan 0.0 (ica yehhuatl) ihuan 1.0 (amo ica yehhuatl).
blockly-MATH_RANDOM_INT_TITLE: mochi tlapoualli zan quenin itech %1 hasta %2
blockly-MATH_RANDOM_INT_TOOLTIP: Xiccuepa ce mochi tlapoualli zan quenin itzalan ome tlamiliztli tlanahuatilli, ica yehhuantin.
blockly-MATH_ROUND_TOOLTIP: Xicyahualo ce tlapoualli tlacpac noso tlatzintlan.
blockly-MATH_SINGLE_TOOLTIP_EXP: Xiccuepa e ipan ce tlapoualli ihuelitiliz.
blockly-MINIMAP_ARIA_LABEL: Tequitiloyan iamatlacuilol tepiton. Xictequihui mitl tlahcuilolmaitl ic ticolinia tequitiloyan.
blockly-PROCEDURES_CALLRETURN_TOOLTIP: Xictequiti tlachiuhcayotl '%1' tlen tequitini oquichiuh ihuan xictequihui tlen quiquixtia.
blockly-PROCEDURES_CALL_DISABLED_DEF_WAR: Amo huel motequitiz tlachiuhcayotl '%1' tlen tequitini oquichiuh pampa itlanextiliz itetl amo tequiti.
blockly-PROCEDURES_DEFNORETURN_TOOLTIP: Quichihua ce tlachiuhcayotl amo ica tlaquixtiliztli.
blockly-PROCEDURES_DEF_DUPLICATE_WARNING: Tlachiyaliztli: Inin tlachiuhcayotl quipia calaquiliztli ompayotl.
blockly-PROCEDURES_IFRETURN_TOOLTIP: Intla ce tlapoualli nelli, xiccuepa ic ome tlapoualli.
blockly-PROCEDURES_IFRETURN_WARNING: Tlachiyaliztli: Inin tetl zan huel motequihuia itic ce tlachiuhcayotl itlanextiliz.
blockly-PROCEDURES_MUTATORCONTAINER_TOOL: Xicaquiti, xicquixti, noso xiquintecpana occepa inin tlachiuhcayotl icalaquiliz.
blockly-SCREENREADER_HINT: Xictequihui mitl tlahcuilolmaitl ic tinehnemiz. Xictlacui %1 ic ticpatlaz tezcapohualoni itlachializ.
blockly-SCREENREADER_MODE_DISABLED: Tezcapohualoni itlachializ amo tequiti, xictlacui %1 ic ticpehualtiz
blockly-SCREENREADER_MODE_ENABLED: Tezcapohualoni itlachializ tequiti, xictlacui %1 ic ticcahuaz
blockly-TEXT_CHANGECASE_TOOLTIP: Xiccuepa ce tlahtolli icopinaliz ica occe tlahcuilolli ihueyiliz.
blockly-TEXT_COUNT_TOOLTIP: Xicpohua quezqui hueli monextia achi tlahtolli itic occe tlahtolli.
blockly-TEXT_CREATE_JOIN_TOOLTIP: Xicaquiti, xicquixti, noso xiquintecpana occepa xeloliztli ic ticyancuiliz inin tlahtolli itetl.
blockly-TEXT_GET_SUBSTRING_START_FROM_EN: xiccui tlahtolontli itech tlahcuilolli # itech tlamiliztli
blockly-TEXT_GET_SUBSTRING_TOOLTIP: Quicuepa ce xeloliztli tlanahuatilli itech tlahtolli.
blockly-TEXT_INDEXOF_TOOLTIP: Quicuepa iyeyan iachtopa/itlatzinilli inezca iachtopa tlahtolli ipan ic ome tlahtolli. Quicuepa %1 intla tlahtolli amo monextia.
blockly-TEXT_ISEMPTY_TOOLTIP: Quicuepa nelli intla tlahtolli tlamacalli cactoc.
blockly-TEXT_JOIN_TOOLTIP: Xicchihua ce tlahtolli ic tiquinnamictiz quezqui tlamantli tlen ticnequi.
blockly-TEXT_LENGTH_TOOLTIP: Quicuepa quezqui tlahcuilolli (ica cactoc yeyan) ipan tlahtolli tlamacalli.
blockly-TEXT_PRINT_TOOLTIP: Xictlilania tlahtolli, tlapoualli noso occe tlapoualli tlanahuatilli.
blockly-TEXT_REPLACE_TOOLTIP: Xicpatla nochi inezca achi tlahtolli itic occe tlahtolli.
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_OPERATOR_BOTH: xicquixti cactoc yeyan ipan ome inacaz
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_TOOLTIP: Xiccuepa ce tlahtolli icopinaliz ica cactoc yeyan tlaquixtilli ipan ce noso ome itlamiliz.
blockly-VARIABLES_SET_TOOLTIP: Quitlalia inin tlapatlani ma san ce ica calaquiliztli.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_ANOT: Ce tlapatlani itocayo '%1' ye onca ica occe nemiliztli: '%2'.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_A_PA: Ce tlapatlani itocayo '%1' ye onca quen calaquiliztli ipan tlachiuhcayotl '%2'.
blockly-WORKSPACE_CONTENTS_BLOCKS_ONE: Ce tepantli itech tetl%2 ipan tequitiloyan.
blockly-WORKSPACE_SEARCH_INPUT_LABEL: Xictemo ipan tequitiloyan. Xictlacui Enter ic occe tlanamiquiliztli, Shift+Enter ic tlanamiquiliztli achtopa. Xictlacui Escape ic tictzacuaz temoliztli ihuan tictlachiliz tlanamiquiliztli axcan.
r-blocks-help: Xicnamicti ce tlapehualtiliztli ica ce tlachihualli. Xicuilana tetl itech tepozcaxitl. Xictequihui amatl itlapatlaloni ic occequintin tlapehpenaliztli.
r-blocks-unavailable: Nahuatilli itlamantli amo onca. Xictequihui amatl itlapatlaloni ic tictlachiliz inin nahuatilli.
r-blocks-invalid: Xicnamicti zan ce tlapehualtiliztli ica ce tlachihualli. Xiquinquixti tetl tlen amo monamiqui noso tlen mocahua achtopa ticpiyaz.
r-blocks-conflict: Inin nahuatilli omopatlac ihcuac ticpatlaya. Xicuica occepa nahuatilli tlapixtli achtopa ticpiyaz.
r-blocks-permission: Monequi huapalli itlayecani ihuelitiliz ic tiquinpatlaz nahuatiltin.
scrum-policy-doneLists: Amatlapalli ipan ce tocatlahtolli Done itlamantli
scrum-rollover-sprint: Xiccuica tequitl tlen amo otlan ipan
scrum-edit-sprint: Xicchihua noso xicpatla ce sprint tlanemililli
scrum-releases-select-help: Ce amatlapalli huel ca ipan miec tlaquixtiliztli. Xicpiya Ctrl (Cmd ipan ce Mac) ic tiquinpehpenaz oc miec; xiquinchipahua nochtin ic ticquixtiz amatlapalli itech nochi tlaquixtiliztli.
scrum-select-sprint: Xicpehpena ce sprint ic tiquittaz itlanonotzaliz.
scrum-backlog-help: Xictecpana tequitl ica itlatecpanaliz. Xiquinmaca amatlapaltin ce sprint tlanemililli noso tlen tequiti.
scrum-no-closed-sprints: Amo onca ce sprint tlatzactli itlachialoni.
scrum-report-help: Tlanonotzaliztli quinpiah tlatemachiliztli itech sprint itlachialoni. Tlatemachiliztli amo machiztli mopohuah ixcahuil; amo yehhuantin cero tlatemachiliztli. Xicnamiqui iciuhcayotl zan itzalan tlatemachiliztli itlamachiyo ihuan nahuatilli tlen monamiquih.
scrum-confirm-close: ¿Xictzacua inin sprint ihuan xicpiya itlaquixtil? Amatlapaltin tlen amo otlanqueh yazqueh campa otitlapehpen.
scrum-confirm-cancel: ¿Xiccahua inin sprint? Iamatlapalhuan quipiazqueh innetechpohualiz hasta occepa momacazqueh.
scrum-partial-report: Tlanonotzaliztli achi: zan amatlapaltin tlen axcan momacah tehhuatl mocalaquiah.
scrum-import-reference-omitted: Ce ihuitzyan inezca amo huel ocuepaloc: __reference__
scrum-partial-snapshot: Inin sprint zan quipia achi itech achtopa tlachialoni.
scrum-resume-close: Xicnemi occepa sprint itzacualiz tlen omocauh
scrum-rollover-progress: In amatlapaltin itech tequitl achitzin cahuitl quinyacapanolintia: __done__ ipan __total__
scrum-history-job-running: Ce hueyi patlaliztli quicuepa nozo occeppa quichihua: __done__ ipan __total__ yehuacayotl tlacuilolli panti
scrum-history-job-failed: Ce hueyi patlaliztli icuepaliz nozo occeppa ichihualiz omocauh. Occeppa xicpachoa xiccuepa nozo occeppa xicchihua inic oc tipanoti:
scrum-daily-observations: Sesen tonalli tequitl ihuan tequitl tlen mocahua (tlachializtli)
scrum-daily-observations-help: Sesen tlaquetzalli quinextia iachtopa tlachializtli tlahcuilolli itech ce UTC tonalli, ipan cahuitl tlen monextia. Tonalli tlen amo oncateh amo monextiah. Inin tlachializtli amo quitlahcuiloah nochi tlapatlaliztli noso amo quinextiah tonalli itlamiliz inechicol. Tlatemachiliztli amo machiztli amo cero. Xictequihui inin xeloliztli iExport ic sesen tonalli tlachializtli; tlaahxitiliztli itlahcuilolpan iExport quiquixtia sprint itlaquixtil.
scrum-daily-truncated: Zan monextiah 366 tlachializtli tlen achi yancuic.
scrum-daily-empty: Amo ce sesen tonalli tlachializtli otlahcuiloloc ic inin sprint.
scrum-scope-history: Ixquich tequitl ihuan in tequitl tlen oc mocahua, cece patlaliztli
scrum-scope-history-help: Occepa motta ipan iyehuacayo in huapalli, ihcuac opeuh in sprint: ce tlacuilolli ipampa cece patlaliztli ipan iamatlapal in sprint, ipan in quezqui tequitl yez nozo ipan in tequitl tlen ye otlan.
scrum-scope-history-inconsistent: In yehuacayotl amo huel quicuepa in tlen inin sprint oquipix: cequi patlaliztli amo omotlacuilo ipan yehuacayotl, ica inin tlapohualli amo ajsitoc.
scrum-scope-history-truncated: Zan in achto patlaliztli ohuel mopouh; in tlen occepa motta amo ajsitoc.
scrum-scope-history-empty: Amo itla omopatla ihcuac opeuh in sprint.
scrum-scope-cause-scrum: Omopatla in tlen poui ipan sprint
scrum-scope-cause-lifecycle: In amatlapalli omohuicac pixcalco nozo omocuep
scrum-daily-observations-export-help: Iachtopa tlachializtli tlahcuilolli itech sesen UTC tonalli; tonalli tlen amo oncateh amo monextiah. Tlachializtli amo quitlahcuiloah nochi tlapatlaliztli noso tonalli itlamiliz inechicol. Tlatemachiliztli amo machiztli amo cero.
scrum-import-pending: Scrum icalaquiliz amo otlan. Scrum itlapatlaliz ihuan tlanonotzaliztli iquixtiliz amo oncateh.
scrum-import-discard: Xictlamotla in tlacalaquiliztli tlen ayamo tlami
scrum-import-recovery-hint: In tlacalaquiliztli tlen omoquetz pampa occepa opeuh, huel tictlamiz nican ihcuac ye omoquetz. Intla in itlatecpanaliz amo nochi omopix, zan huel tictlamotlaz; inon amo itla quipatla ipan huapalli.
scrum-import-into-board: Xiccalaqui Scrum itlanemililiz ipan inin huapalli
scrum-import-into-board-hint: Xicpehpena ce WeKan huapalli iquixtiliz noso Scrum itlanamac. Sprintmeh ihuan tlaquixtiliztli tlen ye quipia inin huapalli mohuilpiah, amo quemman moompayotiah. Amatlapaltin monamiquih ica ID, noso ica amatlapalli itlapohual ihuan itocayo; amatlapaltin tlen amo monamiquih monextiah ihuan amo mopatlah. Achtopa xiquitta tlen mopatlaz.
scrum-import-preview-sprints: Sprintmeh: __created__ yancuic, __matched__ ye ipan inin huapalli, __skipped__ amo ocalaquiloqueh
scrum-import-preview-releases: Tlaquixtiliztli: __created__ yancuic, __matched__ ye ipan inin huapalli, __skipped__ amo ocalaquiloqueh
scrum-import-preview-cards: Amatlapaltin: __updated__ mopatlazqueh, __unchanged__ amo mopatlah, __unmatched__ amo monamiquih
scrum-import-preview-nothing: Amo tlen mopatlaz: inin huapalli ye quipia inin tlanemililiztli.
scrum-import-into-board-done: Scrum itlanemililiz ocalaquiloc ihuan otlahcuiloloc ipan Tlahtollotl.
scrum-import-card-not-matched: Ce amatlapalli amo monextih ipan inin huapalli: __reference__
scrum-import-card-ambiguous: Ce amatlapalli monamiqui ica oc miec amatlapaltin ipan inin huapalli: __reference__
scrum-import-card-on-another-board: Ce amatlapalli itech pohui occe huapalli ihuan amo omopatlac: __reference__
scrum-import-record-ambiguous: Ce sprint noso tlaquixtiliztli monamiqui ica oc miec ipan inin huapalli: __reference__
scrum-import-record-not-imported: Ce sprint, tlaquixtiliztli noso tlamantli amo huel ocalaquiloc: __reference__
scrum-import-sprint-finished: Ce amatlapalli amo ocuicac ipan ce sprint tlamic: __reference__
sync-conflict-hint: Xicpehpena ce tlapoualli sesen netehuiliztli. Namictiliztli occepa quiyehyecoa satepan sesen tlapehpenaliztli. Amo tlen motitlania ipan ihuitzyan.
sync-conflict-refresh: Xictequiti occepa namictiliztli ic tiquittaz tlapoualli axcan.
sync-conflict-review-complete: Moamatlapalhuan tlamacalli otlachialoqueh. Amo mocahua tlalli inetehuiliz. Nochi tocatlahtolli inamictiliz amo otequit.
sync-conflict-detach-hint: Zan xicquixti inin ompayotl inamictiliz. Tlen quipia mocahua ipan WeKan.
sync-conflict-archive: Pixcalli tlatzacuilli pampa amatlapalpipiltin tlen tequitih
sync-conflict-archive-hint: Ihuitzyan itlamantli ye amo onca, zan amatlapalpipiltin tlen tequitih quitzacuah pixcalli. Xicpiya inin amatlapalli nican ic ticquixtiz inamictiliz. Amatlapalpipiltin amo mopatlah.
sync-conflict-creation-hint: Xicpiya amatlapalli achtopa amo tlapatlalli ihuan xicchihua ce yancuic amatlapalli namictiliztli ipan inin tocatlahtolli. Occepa yehyecoliztli quitequihuiah ipatiuh.
sync-preview-saved: Ipan tlaahxitiliztli tlapixtli. Namictiliztli axcan quicui ihuan quitlachilia ihuitzyan occepa.
sync-preview-unavailable: Xicpiya ce namictiliztli ihuitzyan achtopa tictlahtlaniz ce tlachializtli.
sync-preview-blocked: Xiquinyecti netehuiliztli itzintlan achtopa tictlachiliz tlapatlaliztli itlanemililiz.
sync-preview-scope: Tlapoualli quitenehuah ihuitzyan itlal tlayectlalilli. Ihuitzyan itlapohuani huel amo quicalaquiz occe tlamantli.
sync-preview-parser-unsupported: Tlen amo ocalaquiloc ihuan tlapohuani oquihto
sync-source-heading: Ihuitzyan itlal tlen amo mocopinah niman
sync-source-scope: Ohtli quinnechicoah tlalli inezca ipan ihuitzyan itlamantli. Tlamantli amo tlanamictilli motenehuah mochi; intlapohual amo monextia.
sync-source-fallback: Occe tlapoualli tlen tlapohuani amo quitequihuia
sync-source-occurrences: Tlalli noso tlamantli inezca tlen motenehuah
sync-source-truncated: Tlanonotzaliztli zan quipia 100 ohtli ihuan tlaltin intocayo tlatzicuiltilli.
sync-source-omitted: Occequintin nezcayotl quiyahuac ohtli tlen monextiah
sync-report-partial: Tequitiliztli tlen amo ohuel noso amo otlan huel oquinpatlaqueh achi amatlapaltin. Inin tlanonotzaliztli amo quinemitiah occepa noso amo quicuepah ce tequitiliztli.
sync-report-unfinished: Mochiuhtica noso omocauh; amo motlahcuilo tlen oquiz
sync-report-failed: Amo ohuel; huel achi tlapatlaliztli ochihualoc
sync-report-completed-with-warnings: Otlan ica tlaltin tlaquixtilli noso tlacuepalli
sync-report-unavailable: Tequitiliztli itlanonotzaliz quinequi nochi tocatlahtolli itlahcuilolhuelitiliz ihuan ce tlatequipanoani tlen onca.
sync-recovery-description: Namictiliztli itlanonotzaliz tlapixtli itech itlatzinilli 30 tonalli. Xictemo ica huapalli noso tocatlahtolli iID. Ce tlaquixtilli amo otlan huel oc tequiti noso omocauh. Xicyancuili ic occepa tictlachiliz; inin tlanonotzaliztli amo huel quinemitiah occepa noso quicuepah tlapatlaliztli.
sync-recovery-unavailable: Amo huel mopohua namictiliztli itlachializ. Xictlachili tlayecani icalaquiliz ihuan tlatequipanoani.
sync-estimate-field-hint: Xicpehpena ce tlalli ica tlapoualli ica Jira itlal iID ihuan tlatemachiliztli itlamachiyo, quen oquichiuh ce Jira icalaquiliz tlanamictilli. Tlapatlaliztli nican motlachiliah quen netehuiliztli. Ihuitzyan itlapohual tlen amo oncateh amo motlachiliah; ce null nezqui quichipahua tlapoualli tlanamictilli.
sync-estimate-field-gitlab: Canin motlalia in quezqui tequitl yez ipan inin huapalli
sync-estimate-field-gitlab-hint: In GitLab ieticayo nozo in quezqui cahuitl yez motlacuiloa canin ticpehpena in tlapohualli. In nican patlaliztli motlachilia quen tlen amo monamiqui; intla in tequitl amo quipiya eticayotl, in tlapohualli tlen ilpitoc moquixtia.
email-recovery-description: Ce tlahcuilolpantli ipampa ceceyaca tlaseliani. Xictemo ica tequitiliani i-ID. Amo monextia tlahcuilolli itech onca tlamantli niyon tlaseliani itlahcuilol tlanextiloyan. Quetzaliztli quipiya tlahcuilolli tlen axcan onca ihuan tlen zatepan yez; oc ceppa pehualiztli quiyehyecoa axcan quititlaniz tlahcuilolli tlen quichia. Pololiztli quipoloa tlahcuilolli tlen omotlali ipan tocatlahtolli achto noso ipan tlahtlaniliztli icahuitl. Intla titlaniliztli ye mochihua, xicyehyeco oc ceppa achitzin zatepan. Tlahcuilolli tlen ye motitlania amo huel mocuepa, ihuan intla amo machi intla oahcic, huel oc ceppa motitlaniz. Tlahcuilolli tlen nochipa amo huel motitlania ihuan tlen oahcic tlayehyecoliztli itlamiyan oc mopiya inic motlachiliz. Oc ceppa titlaniliztli pehua yancuic tlayehyecoliztli ihuan quipiya quetzaliztli tlen ye onca.
email-recovery-retrying: Tlahcuilolli tlen oc ceppa moyehyecoa quititlaniz
email-recovery-attempts: Oc ceppa tlayehyecoliztli itlapohual cenca hueyi
email-recovery-empty: Amo onca tlahcuilolli tlen quichia niyon tlaselianimeh tlen intitlaniliz omoman.
email-recovery-unavailable: Amo huel mopohua tlahcuilolli itocatlahtol. Xiquitta tlayecani icalaquiliz ihuan intla tepospalehuiani huel tequiti.
email-recovery-busy: Titlaniliztli noso oc ce tequitl ipan tocatlahtolli ye mochihua. Xicyancuicili ihuan xicyehyeco oc ceppa achitzin zatepan.
email-recovery-failed: Amo ohuel moneltili tequitl. Xicyancuicili tocatlahtolli ihuan intla monequi, xicyehyeco oc ceppa in yehuatl tequitl.
email-recovery-superseded: Tequitiliani iyancuic tequiuh oquipatla inin tlahtlaniliztli. Monextia quen axcan cah tocatlahtolli.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Ticnequi ticpolos nochi tlahcuilolli tlen axcan quichia ipampa inin tlaseliani? Tlen itech onca mopoloz ihuan amo huel mocuepaz. Tlahcuilolli yancuic tlen mochihua zatepan inin tlahtlaniliztli mopiyaz.
email-recovery-retry: Xicyehyeco oc ceppa xictitlani tlahcuilolli tlen amo ohuel motitlan
email-failure-recipient-unavailable: Tlaseliani amo onca noso itequiuh amo tequiti
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Tlamacaliztli amo huel moneltili; xictlachili achtopa ticyehyecoz occepa
sync-time-estimate-hint: Cahuitl itlatemachiliz quitequihuiah tlaltin ica tlapoualli achtopa/mocahua cahuitl tlen oquichiuh Jira icalaquiliz. Zan ce tlalli tlen monamiqui monequi onca ipan inin huapalli. Tlapatlaliztli nican motlachiliah quen netehuiliztli; ihuitzyan itlapohual tlen amo oncateh amo motlachiliah ihuan ce null nezqui quichipahua tlapoualli.
sync-planning-hint: Sprint ihuan tlaquixtiliztli zan monamictiah ihcuac Scrum tequiti ipan inin huapalli. Ce sprint noso tlaquixtiliztli tlen amo onca mochihua ipan inin huapalli, ica tonalli tlen ihuitzyan quimaca; ce tlen ye onca achtopa monamiqui ica ihuitzyan iID, satepan ica itocayo. Ce tlanemililiztli tlapatlaliztli nican mocahua hasta ihuitzyan quipatla inon tlahtlaniliztli itlanemililiz, ihuan ce achtopa namictiliztli amo quemman quiquixtia tlanemililiztli.
activity-recovery-description: Tenahuatiliztli tlen amo otlanqueh occepa moyehyecoah ica inselti. Xictlachili tequitiliztli tlen amo oncateh noso omopatlaqueh achtopa ticyehyecoz occepa. Occepa yehyecoliztli amo quemman occepa quichihua ce tequitiliztli.
activity-recovery-empty: Amo onca tequitiliztli itenahuatil tlen mochiya.
activity-recovery-unavailable: Amo huel moquimiloh tequitiliztli itenahuatil tlen mochiyah.
activity-recovery-status-inconsistent: Tlanemililiztli ihuan tequitiliztli tlen mochiya amo monamiquih
activity-recovery-busy: Occe tequitini quichihua inin tenahuatiliztli. Xicyancuili ihuan xicyehyeco occepa.
activity-recovery-denied: Tlaseliani icalaquiliz noso itenahuatil itlanequiliz ayocmo quicahuah tlamacaliztli.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Achtopa tequitiliztli amo onca noso omopatlac. Amo tlen occepa ochihualoc.
activity-recovery-failed: Amo huel otlan tenahuatiliztli itlamacaliz. Tequitl tlen mochiya omopix.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Inin tenahuatiliztli omopatlac ihcuac oquimiloloc. Xictlachili inemiliz yancuic achtopa ticyehyecoz occepa.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Amo huel moneltili tlamacaliztli itlaahxitiliz. Xicyancuili ihuan xictlachili inemiliz axcan.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: ¿Xiccahua mochipa tlamacaliztli tlen mocahua ic inin tequitiliztli? Inin amo huel occepa monemitiz. Tlahcuilolli tlen ye motecpantoc ihuan tenahuatiliztli tlen ye omacaloc amo mocuepah.
rule-email-recovery-description: Xiquitta tlen omihcuiloh quenin omoyeco titlaniz tlanahuatilli itlahcuilolhuan. Tlen ayamo oneltililoc huel oc motitlantoc, anozo otzacuililoc. Xictlapo ce ica "Xicyehyeco" ic oc ceppa xictitlani, xicmachiyoti iuh titlanilli, anozo xicpolo.
rule-email-recovery-invalid: Amo melahuac in tlamatiliztli tlen quipohua quenin omoyeco
rule-email-recovery-empty: Amo onca tlen omoyeco titlaniz tlanahuatilli itlahcuilolhuan tlen inin tlatemoliztli quinequi.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Amo huel moquimiloh nahuatilli itlahcuilol iyehyecoliz. Xicyancuili ic ticyehyecoz occepa.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: WeKan ayic icselti oc ceppa quititlani ce tlahcuilolli tlen amo oneltililoc. Oc ceppa motitlaniz zan intech tlen amo oneltililoc. Xicmachiyoti iuh titlanilli intla ticmati ca oahcic, anozo xicpolo.
rule-email-recovery-wait: In achto titlaniliztli huel oc mochihua. Huel titlatzontequiz zatepan __time__.
rule-email-recovery-resends: Oc ceppa titlaniliztli tlen achtopa omochiuh: __count__
rule-email-recovery-resend: Oc ceppa xictitlani intech tlen amo oneltililoc
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Oc ceppa motitlaniz inin tlahcuilolli intech tlen amo oneltililoc? Intla intlahcuiloltepoz oquicelih ihuan amo oquilhuic WeKan, yehuantin quicelizqueh oppa.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Momachiyotiz inin tlahcuilolli iuh nochtin intech otitlaniloc? Zan xicchihua intla ticmati ca oahcic.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Mopoloz inin tlahcuilolli? Amo motitlaniz intech tlen amo oneltililoc.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: In achto titlaniliztli huel oc mochihua. Oc ceppa xicyehyeco zatepan.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: In oc ceppa titlaniliztli tlen achtopa opeuh huel oc mochihua. Oc ceppa xicyehyeco zatepan.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Nochtin tlen quicelizqueh ye oneltililohqueh. Xicmachiyoti iuh titlanilli.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: In tlahcuiloltepoz amo onanquilic. In tlahcuilolli tlen oc ceppa otitlaniloc huel oahcic anozo amo oahcic; monextia iuh oc mochihua.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Occe tlayacanqui quiyectlalia inin tlahcuilolli. Oc ceppa xicyehyeco achitzin zatepan.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: In tlahcuilolli tlen mopiya aocmo neneuhqui ica inin yehyecoliztli, ica amo huel moyectlalia nican.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: In ihcuilolli tlen mopiya ipampa inin yehyecoliztli amo melahuac, ica amo huel moyectlalia nican.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Amo ohuel moyectlalih inin tlahcuilolli. Xicyancuicili ihuan oc ceppa xicyehyeco.
rule-email-legacy-heading: Nahuatiltin intlahcuilol tlen quichiah ma moyehyeco
rule-email-legacy-description: Inin nahuatiltin intlahcuilol oquicencauh ce WeKan tlen achtopa catca, ihuan amo oquihcuiloh campa hualehua in tlen quipiya. Ica WeKan amo icselti quintitlaniz. Xiquitta intla in tlen oquichih in nahuatilli oc quicahuiliah ma quitta in amatlapalli. Zatepan oc ceppa xiquilpi inic oc ceppa mocencahuaz ica in amatlapalli tlen axcan cah, anozo xicpolo.
rule-email-legacy-reason-details-snapsho: Amatlapalli itlahcuilol ipan ce tlen achtopa catca
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Oc ceppa mocencahuaz inin tlahcuilolli ica in amatlapalli tlen axcan cah? In tlen quipiya huel occe tlamantli yez, amo iuh tlen achtopa omocencauh.
rule-email-legacy-empty: Amo onca nahuatiltin intlahcuilol tlen quichiah ma moyehyeco.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Amo ohuel mocuic nahuatiltin intlahcuilol tlen quichiah ma moyehyeco. Xicyancuicili inic oc ceppa ticyehyecoz.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: In tlen oquichih in nahuatilli aocmo quicahuiliah ma quitta inin amatlapalli, anozo in nahuatilli omopatla. Ica amo huel oc ceppa molpia. Huel ticpoloz.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: In tequitl tlen oquipehualtih inin tlahcuilolli omopatla, ica amo huel oc ceppa molpia. Huel ticpoloz.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: In amatlapalli campa hualehua inin tlahcuilolli aocmo huel mocui, ica amo huel oc ceppa molpia. Huel ticpoloz.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: In nahuatilli itequiuh tlen oquicencauh inin tlahcuilolli aocmo mopiya, ica amo huel oc ceppa molpia. Huel ticpoloz.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Inin tlahcuilolli ye otitlaniloc, ye oquiyecohqueh quititlanizqueh, anozo ye opoloc.
rule-email-legacy-not-legacy: Inin tlahcuilolli ye oc ceppa oilpiloc.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Amo ohuel otlami inin tequitl. Xicyancuicili ihuan oc ceppa xicyehyeco.
stuck-sync-operation-heading: Tocatlahtolli inamictiliz itequitiliz tlen amo huel occepa monemitiah
stuck-sync-operation-description: Sesen inin tocatlahtolli inamictiliz itequitiliz tlapixtli omoquetz ohtlica ihuan ayocmo huel motlamiz, pampa itocatlahtol oquixtiloc, occepa ochihualoc noso occepa otlaahxitiloc, noso tequitini tlen oquipehualti oquipoloh itlahcuilolhuelitiliz. Ihcuac ce mochiya, inon tocatlahtolli amo huel monamictia. Xictlaxa ic tocatlahtolli occepa huel monamictiz: tlapatlaliztli tlen ye omochiuh mocahuah, tlapatlaliztli tlapixtli tlen mocahuah amo quemman motlahcuilozqueh, ihuan occe namictiliztli occepa quinamiqui tocatlahtolli ica ihuitzyan.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: Tocatlahtolli oquixtiloc, occepa ochihualoc noso inamictiliz itlaahxitiliz omopatlac
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: Tequitini tlen oquipehualti ayocmo quipia itlahcuilolhuelitiliz ipan nochi tocatlahtolli
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Omopix ica ce WeKan achtopa amo ica tlen oquipehualti
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: Huel occepa monemitiz axcan ihuan motlamiz ixcahuil, ic amo huel motlaxaz.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: ¿Xictlaxa inin tocatlahtolli inamictiliz itequitiliz tlapixtli? Tlapatlaliztli tlen ye oquichiuh mocahuah; occequintin amo quemman motlahcuilozqueh. Satepan tocatlahtolli huel occepa monamictiz.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: Amo onca tocatlahtolli inamictiliz itequitiliz tlen mochiya tlachializtli.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: Zan monextiah 50 tlen achi huehueh. Xiquintlaxa achi ihuan xicyancuili ic tiquittaz oc miec.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Amo huel moquimiloh tocatlahtolli inamictiliz itequitiliz. Xicyancuili ic ticyehyecoz occepa.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: Inin tequitiliztli amo omonextih moquetztoc, ic amo huel motlaxaz.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: Inin tequitiliztli huel occepa monemitiz axcan ihuan motlamiz ixcahuil, ic amo otlaxaloc.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: Inin tocatlahtolli monamictitica axcan. Xicyehyeco occepa achitzinca.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Amo ohuel otlami inin tequitl. Xicyancuicili ihuan oc ceppa xicyehyeco.
interrupted-import-heading: Huapalli icalaquiliz tlen omoquetzqueh achtopa motlamizquia
interrupted-import-description: Sesen inin huapalli icalaquiliz omoquetz ohtlica - tlatequipanoani occepa opeuh, noso calaquiliztli amo ohuel - ihuan oquicauh ce huapalli achi. Ce calaquiliztli amo huel monemitiz occepa, pampa itlanamac ihuitzyan amo mopiya. Xicpiya huapalli quen ca, noso xictlaxa ihuan xiccalaqui occepa tlanamactli. Tlaxaliztli quiquixtia huapalli tlen inin calaquiliztli oquichiuh ihuan nochi tlen ipan ca, ica tlen satepan omocaquiti.
interrupted-import-scrum: Iscrum itlamantli quipia ixcahuil tlachializtli (__state__, __next__ itech __total__ tlamantli). Intla ticpiya huapalli, xictlami noso xictlaxa itech huapalli iScrum icalaquiliz icuepaliz.
interrupted-import-counts: __swimlanes__ ohtin, __lists__ tocatlahtoltin, __cards__ amatlapaltin, __checklists__ tlanextiliztocatlahtoltin, __comments__ tlahtolpehualiztli, __attachments__ tlanamictilli
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: ¿Xicpiya inin huapalli achi quen ca? Amo tlen moquixtia, ihuan calaquiliztli ayocmo monextia nican.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: ¿Xictlaxa inin calaquiliztli? Huapalli tlen oquichiuh ihuan nochi tlen ipan ca moquixtiah mochipa.
interrupted-import-empty: Amo onca huapalli icalaquiliz tlen omoquetz ihuan mochiya tlachializtli.
interrupted-import-truncated: Zan monextiah 50 tlen achi huehueh. Xicpiya noso xictlaxa achi ihuan xicyancuili ic tiquittaz oc miec.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Amo huel moquimiloh huapalli icalaquiliz tlen omoquetzqueh. Xicyancuili ic ticyehyecoz occepa.
interrupted-import-not-interrupted: Inin calaquiliztli ayocmo mochiya ce tlaixnahuatiliztli.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: Huapalli ica inin id amo oquichiuh inin calaquiliztli, ic amo omotlachiuh.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Iscrum itlamantli oc motlahcuilotica noso mocuepalotica. Xicyehyeco occepa ipan achi cahuitontli.
interrupted-import-failed: Amo ohuel otlami inin tequitl. Xicyancuicili ihuan oc ceppa xicyehyeco.
saml-login-not-started: Inin calaquiliztli ica SAML amo opeuh ipan inin navegador itlapohual. Timitztlatlauhtia, oc ceppa xicalaqui.
history-request-pending-undo: Teposcalli oc ahmo quimelahua in motlacuepaliz itlamian.
history-request-pending-redo: Teposcalli oc ahmo quimelahua in tlen occeppa oticchih itlamian.
history-request-hint: Intla occeppa ticyejyecoa, zan yehuatl tlatlaniliztli occeppa motitlani, ica ahmo quemman huel quicuepa occe tlapatlaliztli.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: Ce tlacuepaliztli, occepa chihualiztli noso Scrum itlapatlaliz icuepaliz omoquetz ipan ce netehuiliztli. Scrum itlapatlaliz ipan inin huapalli motzacuah hasta moyectiliz.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: __applied__ itech __total__ tlapatlaliztli otlahcuiloloqueh, __pending__ amo, ihuan __conflicted__ oquinpatla occe tlacatl satepan.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Tlacuepaliztli quicuepa nochi tlahcuilolli tlapatlalli quen catca achtopa; zan momaca ihcuac ayac occe oquinpatla inon tlahcuilolli satepan. Intla ticpiya huapalli quen ca moquixtia tequitiliztli tlen omoquetz ihuan amo mopatla tlahcuilolli. Quemeh ihuan quemeh, motlahcuiloa ipan Admin Panel, Problems, Recovery.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: ¿Xicpiya nochi tlahcuilolli quen ca axcan, ica tlapatlaliztli tlen tequitiliztli omoquetz ye oquintlahcuilo?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: Ce huapalli itlayecani huel quicuepaz noso quipiyaz huapalli quen ca.
login-setting-clear-secret: Xicquixti in ipatiuh tlen ipan tepachoani ihuapal mopia
login-setting-env-only: Zan tlatequipanoani itlachiyeliz quintlalia inin. Monextiah nican zan ic tlapohualiztli.
email-to-card-description: Tlahcuilolli tiquihualia ipan inechca motlahcuilolhuapal mocuepa amatlapalli ipan inon huapalli.
email-to-card-webhook: URL in webhook calaquiliztli itech tlahcuilolmacani (Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark noso MIME tlanehnemiltiliztli)
email-to-card-secret-saved: Omopix - xiccahua iztac intla ticnequi ticpiyaz
email-to-card-sandstorm-board: Huapalli campa yauh tlahcuilolli tlen moihua inin grain
email-to-card-sandstorm-board-none: Amitla - zan tlahcuilolli ica huapalli machiyotl ipan tlamantli
email-to-card-sandstorm-subject: Xictlali inin ipan tlamantli inic tacitiaz inin huapalli quemeh tehuatl:
email-to-card-address-private: Ichtaca xicpiya: aquin quipiya huel quintlaliz amatlapalmeh quemeh tehuatl.
email-to-card-off-admin-off: In tlahcuilolli selilizti amo omotlali ipan Tepachoani ihuapal.
email-to-card-off-board-off: Ce huapalli tlayecani amo oquitlatih tlahcuilolli inin huapalli.
email-to-card-off-member-off: Otiquintzacuh mohuapal inechcahuan ipan Tlacameh Tlaahxitiliztli.
email-to-card-off-sandstorm-no-session: In grain ayamo quipiya inechca tlahcuilolli. Xicyancuili in amatl.
email-to-card-off-not-authorized: Ticnequi tlahcuiloliztli tlahuelitiliztli ipan inin huapalli.
inbound-account-invalid: Ce IMAP tlahcuilolcaxitl quinequi cualli tlatequipanoani itoca.
feature-views-email-desc: In huapalli quemeh tlahcuilolcaxitl: in tocatlahtolli tlahcuilolli yehuatl Tlahcuilolcalaquiyan, in tocatlahtoltin yehuantin amatlatiloyan, in machiotl yehuantin machiotl, ihuan in tlacameh quihcuiloah ihuan quinanquiliah tlahcuilolli ipan inechca in huapalli.
email-view-not-receiving: Inin huapalli ayamo quiceliya tlahcuilolli. Xictlachiyalti ipan Itlanequiliz tlanonotzaliztli in huapalli → Tlahcuilolli ipan amatlapalli.
email-view-invalid-address: Ce inechca amo cualli tlahcuilolli inechca.
email-view-too-many: Cenca miac tlahcuilolli omotitlan ipan in tlatzacan hora. Occeppa xicyecoa zatepan.
email-view-no-list: In huapalli quinequi ce tocatlahtolli pampa in tlahcuilolli.
feature-views-chat-desc: In huapalli quemeh nenotzalcalli: tequitlalli, huapaltin, ohtin, tocatlahtoltin ihuan amatlapalmeh quemeh cuahuitl apantin, in amatlapalli itlacotian ihuan itlahtolpehualiz quemeh nenotzaliztlahtolli.
chat-view-pick-card: Xicpepena ce amatlapalli ipan apantin inic nican xiquitta.
chat-view-no-messages: Ayamo onca tlahtolli. Xicihcuilo in achto.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Zan yehhuan amatlapalli ipan miac tlacotlaliztli tlatzintlaliz tlen quipiah tocaitl - ica tlamiliztli, achtopa, tlamachiyotl noso occe tlamantli - mohuicah ipan tlacotlaliztli quinhuilanaz.
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Menu → Tenahuatilli quitlanehuia tenahuatilli ica tlen tlacameh quichihuah ica inmah.
feature-board-summary-desc: Menu → Tlanechicolli quiteititia tlen quichiuh cecen tlacatl ipan tlatzacan tonalli noso chicueyetl, ihuan tlen ye opanoc.
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Menu → Ihcuac otiquittac tlatzacan quiteititia tlen oquipatlaqueh occequintin.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Tlatemoliztli quimati tlahtolli quemeh "noamatl tlen ye opanoc".
column-sets-empty: Ayamo onca tlacotlaliztli tlatzintlaliz. Ce tlayecani tlen huapalli huel quichihuaz ce: xictocayoti, zatepan xiquintlali itlacotlalizhuan.
feature-views-version-control-desc: In amatlapalli quemeh GitHub noso Gitea tlaohuiliztli tlatepotztocaliztli: amatlahcuilolli quemeh tlaohuiliztli, machiotl ihuan tlanextilli, tlahtolpehualiztin quemeh nenonotzaliztli, tlanamictilli quemeh amatl, ihuan amatlapalli yehuacayotl ica tlacuepaliztli.
vcs-no-issues: Ahmo onca tlaohuiliztli inic ini tlatemoliztli.
vcs-no-milestones: Ahmo oc onca tlanextilli. Machiotl ica tlamiliztonalli ce tlanextilli.
vcs-no-list: Ini amatlapalli ahmo quipia tlapohualli noso ohtli inic tlaohuiliztli.
card-qr-code-desc: Xictlachiyalti inic xictlapo ini amatlahcuilolli ipan tepozteixmatiliztli noso tablet.
card-qr-code-too-long: In ilpiliztli ini amatlahcuilolli huel huehueyac inic QR tlahcuilolli.
vcs-no-wiki: Ayamo onca wiki. In GitHub necentlaliliztli calaquiliztli quihualhuica nican iwiki ce tlatiliztli.
github-org-import-desc: Nochi tlatiliztli ce necentlaliliztli noso ce tlatequipanohuani mochihua ihuapal, motlapoa ipan Huapalli itlachializ / Tlapatlaliztli tlachiyaliztli: itlaohuiliztin ica intlahtol, inmachiouh ihuan inamauh, itlanextiliztin, iGitHub Actions tequiohtli quemeh Nahuatiltin, ihuan iwiki.
github-org-import-token-hint: Monequi ic ichtacatlatiliztin ihuan ce hueyi API tlantli. Zan mochihua ihcuac tlacalaquilo ihuan aic mopixtoc.
github-org-import-issues: Tlaohuiliztin, ica tlahtolli, machiotl ihuan amatl
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Xicihcuilo itocayo ce necentlaliliztli noso tlatequipanohuani, noso ichan GitHub.
optional-apis-desc: REST API quemeh in API ipan occequintin tlatepotztocaliztli, inic in intequitlalihuan ihuan inscript huelitih quitequipanozqueh inin WeKan quemeh intlatzintlan: tlen quipixqueh mopixtiuh ipan WeKan, ipan WeKan huapaltin. Cecentetl moxoxolotoc ixquichca nican motlamachiyotia. Ayac quipia ixquich itlahuelitiliz: ce tlacuiliani calaqui ica ce WeKan API token ihuan huel quitta ihuan quipatla zan tlen inon tlacatl huel quitta ihuan quipatla ipan WeKan. Mochintin quinequih ma motlatlati in WeKan REST API (WITH_API=true). In calyetlaliztli itzintlan cecentetl yehhuatl tlen quitequipanoa ce tlacuiliani quemeh iservidor.
optional-api-trello-desc: Tequitlaliltin ihuan script tlen omotlahcuiloh ipampa Trello REST API (quemeh Trellinator) tequitih ica WeKan: huapaltin, tocatlahtoltin, amatlapaltin, machiotl, tlacameh, tlahtolpehualiztin ihuan tlanextiliztocatlahtolli. In Trello token ce WeKan API token. Ic moxoxolhuia ce amatlapalli, mopixcaltia ipan WeKan.
optional-api-jira-desc: In tlacuilanimeh ipan Jira REST API v2 tequitih ica WeKan: ce tequitl ce huapalli (itlatlapolhuaz in huapalli itlatlapolhuaz), ce tlaohuiliztli ce amatlapalli (DEV-7), ce quenin ca ce tocatlahtolli, ihuan ce panoliztli quiyolinia in amatlapalli. In tlatemoliztli quiseliya JQL tlen amo ohui: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text ihuan ORDER BY. Xicalaqui ica ce WeKan API token quemeh motlahtolichtacayo. Ic moxoxolhuia ce tlaohuiliztli, mopixcaltia.
optional-api-github-desc: In tlacuilanimeh ipan GitHub REST API ipampa tlaohuiliztin tequitih ica WeKan: ce tlapialoyan ce huapalli, ce tlaohuiliztli ce amatlapalli, ica machiotl, tlanextiltin (machiotl ica ce tlamiliztonalli), tlahtolpehualiztin, ihuan tlapouhqui noso tzactli quemeh ipan Tlapatlaliztli tlachiyaliztli. In token ce WeKan API token.
optional-api-gitea-desc: In tlacuilanimeh ipan Gitea ihuan Forgejo REST API ipampa tlaohuiliztin tequitih ica WeKan, zan quemeh in API tlen monamiqui ica GitHub: ce tlapialoyan ce huapalli ihuan ce tlaohuiliztli ce amatlapalli. In token ce WeKan API token.
bots-none: Ayamo onca tepoztlacameh. Ce tepoztlacatl ce tlatequipanoani ipan moservidor - ce AI tlatequipanoani, ce CI tequitl, ce script - in tlein inin huapalli quimaca amatlapalli.
bot-not-found: Inon tepoztlacatl ahmo onca ipan inin huapalli.
bot-option-not-found: Inon tlanancuililiztli ahmo yehuatl tlein oquimacac in tepoztlacatl.
webhook-internal-hosts-desc: Webhooks tlen quisah amo huelih ahciz tlacanechicolli ipan inechicol WeKan, inic ayac huelitiz quitlachieltiz ce huapalli iwebhook ic ce tlatequipanolli tlen calitic. Xicmicuilo nican in hosts ipan inon nechicolli tlen webhooks huelih ahcih - ce Node-RED, ce tlahtolcalli servidor - ce ipan cecen tlahcuilolli, quemeh tocaitl noso tlacanechicolli, ica ce puerto inic zan inon puerto mochihuaz. Iztac: ayac. Zan tepachoanimeh in tlacatl huelih quipatlah inin amatl.
account-webhook-desc: Ce chantli in WeKan quinahuatia ihcuac aca calaqui nozo mochihua yancuic cuentah. Ahtle mihualia hasta quemman momachiyotia ce tlamantli in tlatzintlan. Quihuica in tlamantli, in tocayotl ihuan in cahuitl; xicmachiyoti occequi zan intla quinequi in aquin quiceliz.
account-webhook-field-ip: IP chantli campa huala in calaquiliztli
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: ¿Xicpolo mochi tlanonotzaliztli tlen quichiya ipan tequitl achi huehueh ica quezqui tonalli?
vcs-synced-from: Omonepano ihuan %s: oncan xictlapo ihuan xictzacua.
vcs-synced-issue: Inin tlaohuiliztli omonepano: xictlapo ihuan xictzacua ipan itlatemoliz.
sync-issue-details: Tlahtolpehualiztin, machiotl, quenin ca ihuan amatl
sync-write-back: Xicmuchihuili tlapatlaliztli in GitLab: tzontecomatl, tlahtolli, tlahtolpehualiztin, tlatzacualiztli ihuan occeppa tlatlapoliztli
sync-write-back-error: Ahmo huelitic in icuiloliztli in GitLab
email-bounces-description: Tlen quichihua WeKan ica tlahcuilolli tlen mocuepa: cantlacatl ahcualli tlahcuilolli, tlahcuilolcaxitl temitica, tenanquiliztli ahmo nican, tlatelchihualiztli ica spam. Cecentlamantli quipia itequiuh, mochihua ihcuac mocuep inon quezquipa.
email-bounces-enabled: Xicpachoa tlahcuilolli tlen mocuepa ipan WeKan
email-bounces-action-stop-email: Ahmo occepa xictitlani tlahcuilolli inin cantlacatl
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: Inin cantlacatl ahmo onca: tlahcuilolahcuiliztli, cuentatl polihqui, tlalli ahmo ixmatic.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: Axcan ahmo oacic: tlahcuilolcaxitl temitica, tlatequipanoani cenca tequipanoa. Zan miyac ce ica ce quitoznequi itlah.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Tenanquiliztli ahmo nican, cehuiliztli noso tlamachiyotl. Tlahcuilolli oacic.
email-bounces-category-complaint-desc: Aquin quiceliz oquimachiyoti tlahcuilolli quen spam.
email-bounces-ses-description: Ipan Amazon SES, xictitlani tlanonotzaliztli Bounce ihuan Complaint, ihuan ce tlanahuatilli ic celiliztli inic cantlacatl canin WeKan titlani, ce tlamantli SNS, ihuan xicmachiyoti inin cantlacatl ipan ica HTTPS:
email-bounces-ses-topics: ARN in SNS tlamantli tlen moceliz, ce ipan cecen tlatlalilli
email-bounces-stopped-only: Zan cantlacatl canin WeKan ahmo occepa titlani tlahcuilolli
email-bounces-clear-hint: Xiquilcahua inin cantlacatl imocuepaliz ihuan occepa xictitlani tlahcuilolli
email-bounce-invalid-topic: Inon ahmo ARN in SNS tlamantli.
email-bounces-providers-description: Intla WeKan tlatitlani ica centetl inin tequitl, xicpehualti, xicmaca tequitl inin cantlacatl webhook ic tlahcuilolli tlen mocuepa ihuan tlatelchihualiztli ica spam, ihuan nican xictlali tlatlapoloni ica quimachiyotia, noso ichtaca tlahtolli tlen otictlali ipan cantlacatl quen https://user:password@… noso ?secret=…
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: Tequitl tlen pehualtilo quinequi itlatlapoloni machiyotl noso ichtaca tlahtolli.
activity-pub-enabled: Tepan huapaltin quitemachiltiah intlatequipanol amatlapalli ipan fediverso (ActivityPub)
activity-pub-desc: Achtopa tzauctoc. Ihcuac motlapoa, cecen tepan huapalli huelitiz motoquiliz ipan Mastodon ihuan occequintin fediverso tlatequipanohuaz-calli quemeh @board-<id> ipan inin WeKan ichan-tlahcuilol, ihuan yancuic amatlapalli tlatequipanoliztli ahci intech in quitoquilia. Zan mopohua: atle tlen quititlani ce fediverso tlatequipanohuaz-calli quipatla ce huapalli, ihuan ichtacayo huapaltin aic momachiltiah.
caldav-sync-desc: Xictlali in itlamiliztonal in amatlapalli ipan inin huapalli ipan ce tonalamatl - Nextcloud Calendar nozo zazo tlein CalDAV tonalamatl. Ce tlamiliztonalli tlen moolinia ipan tonalamatl mocuepa ipan amatlapalli. Xictequiuhti ce ichtaca tlahtolli ic tlatequipanoltilli, amo moichtaca tlahtol.
caldav-invalid-url: In tonalamatl ichan-tlahcuilol monequi ma yez ce http:// nozo https:// ichan-tlahcuilol, amo ica itoca tlatequitiltiani nozo ichtaca tlahtolli itech.
caldav-not-linked: Achtopa xicpiya ce tonalamatl ichan-tlahcuilol ihuan xictlapo nenepanoliztli.
webdav-storage-description: Xicpiya tlanamictilli ipan ce amachiquihuitl ipan ce WebDAV tlatequipanohuaz-calli - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud nozo occe. Xictequiuhti ce ichtaca tlahtolli ic tlatequipanoltilli tlen mochiuh ic WeKan. Nican huelitiz motequiuhtiz ce tlatequipanohuaz-calli ipan WeKan iyoca tlahtlapitzalli, ipampa zan ce tepachoani quitlalia inin ichan-tlahcuilol.
sqrl-desc: Ahmo motlaliani achtopa. In ihcuac motlaliani, in calaquiliztli amatl quitemaca SQRL, auh in tlacameh achtopa quicaquitiah inSQRL ixiptlayo itech Tlacatl tlaahxitiliztli. SQRL quinequi ma WeKan cah ipan ce https:// tlaixquetzalli.
sqrl-scan: Xiquixcopina in tlahtolmachiyotl ica motepoztlachihual SQRL, noso xictlapo moSQRL tepoztlatequipanoh ipan inin tepoztli.
sqrl-expired: Inin SQRL machiyotl ye opoliuh icauhca. Xipehua occeppa.
sqrl-needs-https: SQRL quinequi ma WeKan cah ipan ce https:// tlaixquetzalli.
sqrl-description: Xicalaqui ica moSQRL ixiptlayo ipan ichtaca tlahtolli. Xicaquiti nican cecpa ica moSQRL tepoztlatequipanoh; huel ticquixtiz nican quemmanian.
sqrl-disabled-by-client: In calaquiliztli ica SQRL omotzacuh inic inin cuenta ica moSQRL tepoztlatequipanoh. Xictlapo occeppa ompa ica motemaquixtiliz machiyotl.
sqrl-only-on: MoSQRL tepoztlatequipanoh oquitzacuh inin cuenta zan ica SQRL: occequintin calaquiliztli ohtli moilcahuah.
sqrl-hardlock-on: MoSQRL tepoztlatequipanoh cenca oquitzacuh inin cuenta: ichtaca tlahtolli yancuiliztli ihuan tlahcuilolli patlaliztli moilcahuah.
sqrl-only: Inin cuenta calaqui zan ica SQRL.
sqrl-hardlock: Inin cuenta motzacuh ica SQRL: ahmo huel occeppa mocui nozo mopatla ica occe ohtli.
windows-sso-failed: Ahmo ohuel calac ica Windows. Achtopa amo tlen moamatlacuiloltzin Windows nican quicahua.
enrollment-password-instructions: Xiquixtili motlatzin tlahtolli ic tipehuaz. Inin amo mitzcalaquia. Ce tlachihualiztli tlen ye nemi amo huel mopatla nican.
enrollment-setup-denied: Amo huelitl mopehua tlatecpanaliztli. Xiquitta motlaneltililiz ihuan intla ye motequiuhtia in cemmanyan tlahtolmachiyotl.
enrollment-code-instructions: Xiquintequiuhti tlahtolmachiyotl tlen ipan cahuitl: SHA1, chicuace tlapohualli, 30 tlapohualtzintli. Xicpiya in tlatlatiliztli. Inin tlatecpanaliztli tlami ipan macuilli tlapohualcahuitl.
enrollment-confirmed-instructions: In tlaneltililiztli tlahtolmachiyotl ye motequiuhti. Xicchiya ce yancuic tlahtolmachiyotl ipan motlaneltililoni achtopa ticalaquiz.
registration-first-admin: Inin achtopa tlapohualli yez Domain Global Admin.
auth-too-many-attempts: Miac tlayeyecoliztli ic calaquiz. Xiquiyeyeco zatepan.
registration-global-admin-disabled: In Global Admin tlapohualli mopehua nican. In mochintin intlamachiyotiliz motzacuhtoc.
registration-password-unavailable: Amo onca tlamachiyotiliztli ica tlatlatilli tlahtolli.
expedite-limit: Zan ce tlapoalli amatlapalli ipan huapalli huel iciuhca ipan ce cahuitl.
list-policy-placeholder: ¿Quemman huel calaqui ce amatlapalli ipan inin tocatlahtolli, auh quemman tlami nican?
commitment-point-hint: Ipan inin tocatlahtolli peuhqui tequitl motlaquetza; in tocatlahtolli achtopa tlaixpepenaliztli.
person-wip-over: __user__ quipia __count__ tlapouhtoc amatlapaltin; WIP nepantlaliztli ce tlacatl __limit__.
feature-list-policies-desc: Tenahuatilli ce ce tocatlahtolli - quemman calaqui amatlapalli auh quemman tlami - ipan itzontecon tocatlahtolli. Motlachia ce ce huapalli ipan Huapalli tlaahxitiliztli / Tocatlahtolli.
feature-commitment-point-desc: In tocatlahtolli campa motlaquetza tequitl, machiyotilli ipan itzontecon. Mopepena ce ce huapalli ipan Huapalli tlaahxitiliztli / Tocatlahtolli.
feature-person-wip-limit-desc: Quezquich tlapouhtoc amatlapaltin huel quipia ce tlacatl ipan huapalli; ce tlapouhtoc amatlapalli quinnotza aquin panhuetzi. Motlalia ce ce huapalli ipan Huapalli tlaahxitiliztli / Tocatlahtolli.
feature-standup-timer-desc: Sesen tonalli nechicoliztli ipan huapalli tlatecpanaliztli: in tlacameh ipan huapalli ahmo tlatecpantli, ceceyaca ica in zan ce cahuitl. Motzacua ipan cecen huapalli ipan Scrum itlaahxitiliz.
feature-retrospective-board-desc: Huapalli tlacuepaliztli ipan huapalli tlatecpanaliztli: yancuic ichtaca huapalli ica Xipeua xicchihua, Ma ticcahua, Ma tiquitzquia ihuan Tequitl monequi. Motzacua ipan cecen huapalli ipan Scrum itlaahxitiliz.
show-split-lists: Ma motequi in tocatlahtoltin ipan Mochiuhtica ihuan Otlan
feature-split-lists-desc: Ce tocatlahtolli tectli ipan Mochiuhtica ihuan Otlan: amatlapalli tlen omachiyotiloc quemeh otlan ompa quichiya, tlayohuatoc, ma quitilanacan ipan occe tocatlahtolli, ihuan itzontecon tocatlahtolli quipohua ominti. Mocahua ipan cecen huapalli ipan Huapalli tlaahxitiliztli / Tocatlahtolli, satepan mopehualtia ipan itlaahxitiliz cecen tocatlahtolli.
workload-intro: In horas tlen motlapohua ihuan in tlapohualli tlen amatlapaltin tlen momaca cecen tlacatl, chicomeilhuitl ica chicomeilhuitl, ihuan in horas tlen quipia: itequicahuitl, iamoyeliz ihuan in altepeilhuitl. Xicpacho ce chicomeilhuitl ic tiquittaz iamatlapaltin.
workload-truncated: Cenca miac ic monextiz zan cepa: in amatl quinextia zan achtopa tlacah ihuan amatlapaltin. Xicpepena achi chicomeilhuitl noso achi huapaltin.
workload-allocations-intro: Quezqui in icahuitl ce tlacatl yauh ce huapalli, noso tlen tequitl quinequiz ce huapalli achtopa motocamaca aquin.
workload-invalid-estimate: In tlapohualiztli monequi itzalan 0 ihuan 10000 horas.
feature-workload-desc: Tequiyotl ihuan ihuelitiliz ipan itlatecpan tlatequitiltiani: horas motlapohua ihuan tlapohualli tlen amatlapaltin cecen tlacatl, chicomeilhuitl ica chicomeilhuitl, ihuan itequicahuitl, iamoyeliz ihuan altepeilhuitl, ica tlamacaliztli huapaltin ihuan tequitl tlen moixpatla.
billing-intro: In huapalli tlein tiitlayecani: intomintlaliliz, quezqui omixtlaxtlauh ihuan quezqui mixtlaxtlahuaz intequiuh ica in tlaxtlahuilli ce hora tlein ticchihua, ihuan in tlaxtlahuilamatl in horas tlein omopoloque. Zan in tlayecanih huapalli quitta inin.
billing-unrated: __hours__ h amo quipia tlaxtlahuilli ce hora ihuan amo tlapatiyotilli. Xicchihua ce tlaxtlahuilli ic in huapalli noso ic inon tlacah.
billing-nothing-to-invoice: Nochi hora tlein motlaxtlahuiz ye omotlaxtlahuilamapouh.
billing-set-rate-first: Achtopa xicchihua ce tlaxtlahuilli ce hora ic inin huapalli.
feature-billing-desc: Tomintlaliliztli ihuan tlaxtlahuiliztli ipan in tlatequipanoani imenu: in huapalli itomintlaliliz ica tomin noso horas, tlaxtlahuilli ce hora, intlaxtlahuil ihuan in achtopa tlachiyaliztli intequiuh, ihuan in tlaxtlahuilamatl in horas tlein motlaxtlahuiz tlein omopoloque. Zan in tlayecanih huapalli quitta.
billing-include-undated: Xicaqui cahuitl tlen ihcuiloc achtopa ic tonalli mopiaya
billing-undated-included: Quipia __hours__ h tlen ihcuiloc achtopa ic tonalli mopiaya.
billing-field-promptpay-target: Tlapohualli tepoztlatolli, ID altepetl noso ID tomincuetlaxtli
billing-field-proxy: Tlapohualli tepoztlatolli, UEN, ID FPS noso amatlahcuilolli
billing-uncosted: __hours__ h amo quipia tlapatiyotl ce hora ihuan amo cateh ipan tlapatiyotl.
billing-bill-time: Xictlaxtlahuilamatili cahuitl ica horas (amo: ce tlaxtlahuilli amo mopatla, zan tlaxtlahuilli ihuan tlacohualiztli motlaxtlahuilamatiliah)
billing-fees: Tlaxtlahuilli amo mopatla ihuan cecen metztli
billing-fees-intro: Ce tlamantli nozo ce tlaxtlahuilli amo mopatla motlaxtlahuilamatilia ceppa, ipan itonal; tlaxtlahuilli cecen metztli cecen metztli ipan itonal ixquichca itlamian.
billing-unapproved: __hours__ h quichiyah yectenehualiztli ihuan amo cateh ipan inin tlaxtlahuilamatl.
billing-quotes-intro: Ce tlanahuatilli patiyotl quipatiyotilia tequitl in oc monequi - in tlanemililiztli cecen amatlapalli tlapouhtoc ica in cahuitl omopolo - ihuan tlaxtlahuilli ayamo motlaxtlahuilamatilia.
billing-accept-sets-budget: Tlanahuatilli patiyotl omoceli mochihua itomintlaliliz in huapalli
workload-utilization-title: Horas motlaxtlahuiz omotlahcuiloh ica in tequicahuitl inin chicomeilhuitl
cloud-panel-settings-intro: Ipan Ichan Cloud Panel, in SuperAdmin quimpiya in domain tlacohuanimeh, intlapiyalizcal, in DNS CloudFlare ihuan in Caddy ohtli, auh cecentetl tlacohuani quitta itlaxtlahuilamauh ihuan monotza ica in SuperAdmin. In SuperAdmin ce WeKan tlayacanqui ye onca.
cloud-panel-cloudflare-target: In canin quitlatlapalhuia in domain (ce IP tlacaquiztli nozo itoca host)
cloud-panel-dns-apply: Xicchihua ihuan xicyancuili in DNS tlahcuilolli
cloud-panel-dns-conflict: __name__ ye quipia ce __type__ tlahcuilolli: mocahua quenin catqui.
cloud-panel-caddy-intro: Caddy quihuica in Ichan Cloud Panel ihuan cecentetl domain tlen mocemmaca ic inin WeKan, ihuan cecentetl domain ica itlapiyalizcal ic ipropio WeKan contenedor.
cloud-panel-customers: Tlacohuanimeh tlen nican calaquih (intoca nozo incorreo)
cloud-panel-domain-cloudflare: Xicpiya in DNS tlahcuilolli ipan CloudFlare
cloud-panel-import-files: __count__ tlanechicolli: noihqui xiccopina in amatl ipan itlapiyal huehue WeKan.
cloud-admin-not-allowed: Cloud Admin zan ipan in tlanahuatilli tlen in CLOUD tlaixpantilli tlen servidor tocaitia, ipampa itlapialhuan Cloud huan ipampa tlanamacani tlen dominios tlen tlatlalilia.
cloud-allowed-addresses-desc: IPv4 huan IPv6 tlanahuatilli, huan tlanahuatilli ixquich quen 203.0.113.0/24, campa se Cloud Admin huelitiz ommocalaquiz. Ce ipan cada tlahcuilolli. Xōchitl: ixquich tlanahuatilli.
cloud-allowed-addresses-lockout: Motlanahuatil __address__ amo ipan inin amatlahcuilolli. Intlapiyaliz mitztlatzacuiliz, ic amo motlapialo.
admin-panel-allowed-addresses-desc: In IPv4 ihuan IPv6 tlanahuatilmeh ihuan in tlanahuatil tlamantli, ce ipan cecen tlatlilantli, campa huel motequitiltia in Tepachoani ihuapal ihuan in admin REST API. Atle: zazo tlein tlanahuatil.
admin-panel-allowed-addresses-env: In tlatequitiltiloni ADMIN_PANEL_ALLOWED_IP_ADDRESSES quitlalia, amo inin amatl.
admin-panel-address-refused: Amo huel motequitiltia in Tepachoani ihuapal ipan motlanahuatil __address__.
website-view-empty: Ayamo itla moteittitia ipan inin tlamachiyotlatlapalli.
feature-views-website-desc: In huapalli quemeh tlamachiyotlatlapalli: in amatlapalli ipan itocatlahtol Published, in ohtli Pages quemeh tlaahxitiliztli ihuan occequintin amatlapalli quemeh tlahcuilolli, in yancuic achtopa, ica intlanamictil. Ce tepan huapalli huel motlapoa ipan inin, inic in tecalcoanih quittazqueh in tlamachiyotlatlapalli ipan ichan in huapalli.
feature-views-shop-desc: In tlamantli ipan huapalli iamatlapalhuan quen tlanamacoyan ipan Internet: ce amatlapalli ica ipatiyo ce tlamantli, imachiohuan yehuantin in neneuhcayotl, ihuan ce tlaihtlaniliztli ce amatlapalli ipan tocatlahtolli Tlaihtlaniliztin. Ce huapalli ixquichtin ipan hueliz motlapoa, inic in calaquinimeh quicohuah ipan huapalli ichan.
shop-sale-lists: Tocatlahtoltin tlanamacoh (ahtle tlamachiyotilli: mochi tocatlahtolli zan ahmo in tocatlahtolli Tlaihtlaniliztin)
shop-category-labels: Machiotl monextia quen neneuhcayotl (ahtle tlamachiyotilli: mochi machiotl)
shop-orders-private: In tlaihtlaniliztin mihcuiloah ipan ce huapalli ichtacayotl, ipampa ce huapalli ixquichtin quinextia mochi amatlapalli ixquichtin.
shop-guest-checkout: Calaquinimeh ahmo quipiyah cuenta hueliz tlaihtlanizqueh
shop-show-on-public: Xicnexti in Tlanamacoyan ipan ixquichtin huapalli
shop-show-on-public-note: Ce huapalli ixquichtin motlapoa zan ipan ce itlachializ. Intla nican ticpepena in Tlanamacoyan, quipatla __view__ inic calaquinimeh, ihuan intla ticpepena Tlamachiyotlatlapalli noso occe itlachializ ipan Huapalli tlaahxitiliztli / Huapalli itlachializ, quipatla in Tlanamacoyan.
shop-empty: Ayamo onca tlamantli. Ce amatlapalli ica ipatiyo ipan ce tocatlahtolli tlanamacoh ce tlamantli.
shop-privacy-note: Motoca ihuan monemachiliz mihcuiloa ipan tlaihtlaniliztli inic in tlanamacoyan quihuicaz, ihuan ahcampa occe.
shop-price-changed: Ce patiyotl omopatlac. Xiquitta in yancuic tlapohualli ihuan occeppa xitlaihtlani.
shop-confirmation-email: Xiquihuali in tlacohqui ce tlanahuatilli ica tlahcuilolli in omacic motlaihtlaniliz
import-board-instruction-wordpress: Ipan WordPress, xicpepena 'Tools', 'Export', 'All content' ihuan 'Download Export File', ihuan nican xicpepena inon amatl .xml, nozo xiquipiqui itlahcuilol. Squarespace, Wix ihuan occequintin tlamachiyotlatlapalli tlen quiquixtiah ce amatl WordPress zan no iuhqui tequitih. Cecen amaixtli ihuan cecen tlahcuilolli mochihua ce amatlapalli ipan itocatlahtol in quenin cah, in amaixtli ipan ohtli Pages ihuan in tlahcuilolli ipan Posts, ica itlapiyaliz, itlamantli ihuan itags quemeh machiotl, ihuan itlahtolpehualiz tlen omoceliqueh.
import-board-instruction-wordpressjson: Xicpiya in tlahcuilolli ihuan in amaixtli in WordPress REST API (/wp-json/wp/v2/posts ihuan /wp-json/wp/v2/pages) quemeh ce amatl .json, ihuan nican xicpepena nozo xiquipiqui. Cecen amaixtli ihuan cecen tlahcuilolli mochihua ce amatlapalli ipan itocatlahtol in quenin cah.
import-board-instruction-ghost: Ipan Ghost, xicpepena 'Settings', 'Labs', 'Export your content', ihuan nican xicpepena in amatl .json nozo xiquipiqui. Cecen amaixtli ihuan cecen tlahcuilolli mochihua ce amatlapalli ipan itocatlahtol in quenin cah, ica itags quemeh machiotl.
import-board-instruction-blogger: Ipan Blogger, xicpepena 'Settings', 'Back up content', ihuan nican xicpepena in amatl .xml nozo xiquipiqui itlahcuilol. Cecen tlahcuilolli ihuan cecen amaixtli mochihua ce amatlapalli, in ayamo tlami ipan tocatlahtolli Draft, ica imachiouh ihuan itlahtolpehualiz.
import-board-instruction-markdownsite: Xictzacua ipan ce .zip in itzinpeuhca ce tlamachiyotlatlapalli Hugo, Jekyll, Eleventy, Astro nozo occe tlen amo mopatla - in amatl Markdown ica infront matter, ihuan imixiptla - ihuan nican xicpepena in .zip. Cecen amatl Markdown mochihua ce amatlapalli: tlahcuilolli itech in posts nozo ica ce tonalli ipan itoca in amatl, in occequintin amaixtli, in ayamo tlami ipan tocatlahtolli Draft, ihuan in ixiptla tlen quitequitiltia quemeh itlanamictil.
import-board-instruction-htmlsite: Xictzacua ipan ce .zip in iamauh ce tlamachiyotlatlapalli - iamaix .html ihuan imixiptla, quemeh omopiyaqueh ica wget nozo HTTrack, nozo tlen Medium quiquixtia - ihuan nican xicpepena in .zip. Cecen amaixtli mochihua ce amatlapalli ica itlahcuilol, ihuan in ixiptla tlen quitequitiltia quemeh itlanamictil; in scripts, tlaahxitiliztli ihuan amatlahtlaniliztli moquixtiah.
import-board-instruction-substack: Ipan Substack, xicpepena 'Settings', 'Exports', 'Create new export', ihuan nican xicpepena in .zip tlen otictemouh. Cecen tlahcuilolli mochihua ce amatlapalli ica itlahcuilol, moteittitia nozo ayamo tlami.
help-board-view-swimlanes-what-it-is-des: Ohtin quixexeloah in huapalli ipan pantli ahcopa, inic cecen amatlapalli itech pohui ce tocatlahtolli ihuan ce ohtli. Ce ohtli huel quinextia ce tequihuahcayotl, ce tlacatl, ce tlacohuani noso ce tequitl, auh in tocatlahtoltin zan quinextiah in tequitl itlamantiliz.
help-board-view-swimlanes-how-it-works-d: Xicpachoa + ipan ohtli itzontecon, noso xicpepena Xicaquiti ohtli ipan itlaahxitiliz, xictlahcuilo ce tocaitl ihuan xicpepena intla yauh icpac noso itlan in ohtli tlapepenalli. Intla tiquinpachoa miec tlahcuilolpantli, huel mochihua ce ohtli ica cecen pantli. Xicpachoa ce tocaitl inic ticpatlaz, xictequi in machiyotl inic ticpiloz noso ticzohuaz ce ohtli, xicuilana itzitzquiyan inic tiquintecpanaz in ohtin, ihuan xicuilana itzintlan inic ticpatlaz iquiyahuacayo, intla amo ce huapalli tepachoani oquitzacuh in patlaliztli.
help-board-view-lists-what-it-is-descrip: In tocatlahtoltin yehhuantin in tlaquetzaltin tlein quinpiah in amatlapaltin. Ipan ce kanban huapalli cecen tocatlahtolli ce tequitl itlamantiliz, auh ce amatlapalli mozacatiuh tocatlahtolli ihuicpa tocatlahtolli in iuh tequitl yauh. Ipan Ohtin itlachializ ce tocatlahtolli huel itech pohui ce ohtli.
help-board-view-lists-how-it-works-descr: Xicpachoa in machiyotl inic ticaquitiz tocatlahtolli ipan iyecma tocatlahtolli itzontecon, noso Xicaquiti ipan tocatlahtolli itlaahxitiliz, xictlahcuilo ce tocaitl ihuan xicpepena tlein tocatlahtolli quitoquiliz; intla tiquinpachoa miec tlahcuilolpantli, huel mochihua ce tocatlahtolli ica cecen pantli. Xicpachoa ce tocatlahtolli itzontecon inic ticpatlaz, auh in machiyotl ipan itzontecon zan mohuantzinco quipiloa noso quizohua. In tocatlahtolli itlaahxitiliz no quipia xicmachiyoti, xicnecahualti ihuan pixcalli, ihuan huel ticuilanaz in itzitzquiyan inic tocatlahtoltin inic tiquinpatlaz inpatlahuaca ihcuac mohuelitia.
help-board-view-table-what-it-is-descrip: In Tlatecpantli itlachializ quinextia in huapalli iamatlapalhuan iuhqui ce tlapohualamatl, ce tecpantli ica cecen amatlapalli, ihuan itocatlahtol, iohhuan, itlacahuan, imachiohuan ihuan itonalhuan. Cualli inic tiquinitta miec amatlapaltin zan ceppa, ihuan inic tiquinaquitiz noso tiquinzacaz amatlapaltin ahmo tiquinhuilanaz tocatlahtoltin ipan.
help-board-view-table-how-it-works-descr: Xicpachoa ce tlaquetzalli itzontecon inic tiquintecpanaz, ihuan occeppa inic ticcuepaz in tecpanaliztli. Xictlahcuilo ipan tlatemoliztli inic tiquinnamiquiz amatlapaltin intzontecon, tocatlahtoltin, ohtin ihuan machiotl, ihuan xicpachoa Achtopa ihuan Niman inic tiquinittaz 25 tecpantli ceppa. In Xicpatla tlapachololli quitlapohua ce amatlapalli icpac in tlatecpantli. help-board-view-cal-what-it-is-descripti: In Tonalamatl itlachializ quintlalia in huapalli iamatlapalhuan ipan tonalamatl ica intonalhuan: ce amatlapalli ica itzinpehualiz ihuan itlamiliz tonalli iuhqui ce mecatl inic yehhuantin, auh itonal in oquicelih, itlamiliztonal ihuan itlamiliz iuhqui inneyoliz tlatlaliltin. help-board-view-cal-how-it-works-descrip: Xicpachoa Axcan, Achtopa ihuan Niman inic timozacaz, ihuan xicpatla inic tonalli, chicomeilhuitl ihuan metztli, cecen iuhqui tlatecpantli noso tocatlahtolli. Xicuilana ce amatlapalli inic ticmacaz yancuic tlamiliztonalli, noso xicmahuili inic ticpatlaz itlamiliz tonal. Xicpachoa ce tonalli, noso xicuilana ipan horas ipan chicomeilhuitl noso tonalli itlatecpantli, inic ticchihuaz yancuic amatlapalli tlein ihcuac tlami; yauh ipan huapalli iachtopa ohtli ihuan iachtopa tocatlahtolli.
help-board-view-calendar-mode-what-it-is: Tonalamatl itlamantiliz quinextia cecen amatlapalli ipan itlamiliztonal, ica imachiohuan ihuan itzontecon mochi, ipan metztli noso chicomeilhuitl itlatecpantli. Zan tlachialoni, ce ixtlachializtli tlein ihcuac tlami, iuhqui in Trello itonalamauh.
help-board-view-calendar-mode-how-it-wor: Xicpachoa Axcan, Achtopa ihuan Niman inic timozacaz ce metztli noso ce chicomeilhuitl, ihuan Chicomeilhuitl noso Metztli inic ticpatlaz in tlatecpantli; in tlapepenalli mopia ipan inin tepoztlachiyaloni. Xicpachoa ce amatlapalli inic ticpohuaz. In amatlapaltin pixcalco amo monextiah ihuan in tenco Tlaixpehpenaliztli motequitiltia. Intla ticnequi tiquinpatlaz tonaltin ica huilanaliztli, xictequiti in Tonalamatl itlachializ.
help-board-view-multiboard-cal-what-it-i: Miec Huapaltin Itonalamauh quinextia in amatlapaltin ica tonalli ipan mochintin huapaltin ipan titlacatl, ipan ce tonalamatl, inic huel tiquittaz mochi tlein tlami inin chicomeilhuitl, zan quenin huapalli ipan ca. Cecen tlatlalilli pehua ica ihuapal itzontecon ipan tlatzacuilli.
help-board-view-multiboard-cal-how-it-wo: Xictlapo ipan Huapalli itlachializ itlaahxitiliz ipan zazo tlein huapalli ihuan xicchiya ixquich moaxitiah in amatlapaltin ipan mochintin mohuapalhuan. Xicpachoa Axcan, Achtopa ihuan Niman ihuan in tonalli, chicomeilhuitl ihuan metztli itlachializ, cecen no iuhqui tocatlahtolli. In oquicelih, itlamiliztonal ihuan itlamiliz quipiah inneyoliz tlatlaliltin. Xicpachoa ce tlatlalilli inic ticpohuaz inon amatlapalli ipan ihuapal. Nican amo huel tiquinhuilanaz tonaltin.
help-board-view-time-what-it-is-descript: Cahuitl itlachializ quicentlalia in huapalli icahuitl itlapohualiz ipan ce tlalli: quezqui cahuitl omotequitih, aquin ihuan ipan tlein amatlapaltin, ihuan quezqui cahuitl oc mocahua ixquich tlamih in amatlapaltin. In cahuitl motlalia ipan amatlapaltin; inin tlachializtli zan quinextia.
help-board-view-time-how-it-works-descri: Xicpohua in tlahtolcentlaliliztli ica cahuitl omotequitih ipan tlacpac, niman in tlaxexeloliztli ica tlanahuatilli ihuan ica amatlapalli, ihuan machiyotilli in amatlapaltin tlein oquipanahuih in cahuitl. Itlan, cecen patlaliztli ipan ce amatlapalli ihorahuan motecpana ica tlacatl tlein oquichiuh. Xicpachoa Xicquixti inic ticpiyaz in tlapohualamatl iuhqui PDF noso Excel. In tlacameh tlein zan huel quinittah amatlapaltin tlein inpan omotlalih quicelih in tlahtolcentlaliliztli ica imamatlapalhuan, auh in occequintin tlaxexeloliztli mocahuah iztlacatl.
help-board-view-timeline-what-it-is-desc: Tonalli Ohtli itlachializ quinextia in huapalli in iuh catca ipan ce achtopa cahuitl, ica huapalli itlahtollo. Mitzpalehuia inic tiquittaz tlein omopatlac ihuan inic ticcuepaz ce amatlapalli in iuh catca.
help-board-view-timeline-how-it-works-de: Xicpachoa ce machiyotl ipan mecatl inic tiquittaz cecen amatlapalli in iuh catca ihcuac, centlalilli ica itocatlahtol ipan inon cahuitl, ica itzontecon, itlahtol, imachiohuan, itlacahuan ihuan itlamiliztonal. Xicpachoa Axcan inic ticcuepaz axcan cahuitl. Ipan ce amatlapalli, Xiccuepa inin tlamantiliztli quicuepa inon tlamantli ihcuac otiquelnamiquih. Atle mopoloa: in cuepaliztli mopia iuhqui yancuic tlahtollotl, ihuan in tlapachololli zan monextia intech tlacameh tlein huel quipatlazqueh inon amatlapalli.
help-board-view-stats-what-it-is-descrip: Tlapohualiztli quinextia in huapalli itlamantiliz zan ce ixtlachializtica: quenin moaxitiah iamatlapalhuan ihuan quezqui ohtin, tocatlahtoltin, amatlapaltin, amatlapaltin pixcalco, machiotl, tlacameh ihuan monemac tlalli quipia.
help-board-view-stats-how-it-works-descr: Xictlapo Tlapohualiztli ipan Ixtlachializtli itlacentlaliliz ipan Huapalli itlachializ itlaahxitiliz ihuan xicpohua Huapalli itlamantiliz itlatecpan. Amatlapaltin iaxitiliz quitoa intla inin huapalli zan quinaxitia in amatlapaltin tlein monextiah noso mochintin, ihuan intla inon omopepenac ica ixcomatic ipan ce huei huapalli. In tlapohualli mochihuah ipan tlatequipanoani, inic melahuac ipan ce huei huapalli. Zazo tlein huel ticpepenaz ihuan ticmachiyotiz, ihuan in tlapohualiztli atle quipatla.
help-board-view-group-by-assignee-what-i: Xiquincentlali ica Tlanahuatilli quintecpana cecen amatlapalli itlan in tlacatl ipan omotlalih, amo itlan itocatlahtol, inic huel tiquittaz aquin tlein quipia ahmo ticpohuaz cecen tocatlahtolli. Cualli ipan tequihuahqueh innechicoliz.
help-board-view-group-by-assignee-how-it: Xictlapo ipan Huapalli itlachializ itlaahxitiliz. Cecen tlanahuatilli quipia ce tlaxexeloliztli ica iamatlapalhuan, in tlamiliztonalli intla onca ihuan ce tepozcahuitl ihcuac ce amatlapalli oquipanahuih icahuiuh; in amatlapaltin ahmo tlanahuatilli moquetzah itlan Ahmo tlanahuatilli. Xicpachoa ce amatlapalli itzontecon inic ticpohuaz. In centlaliliztli quitequitiltia in amatlapalli Itlanahuatil itlal, amo Itlacahuan. In tlacameh tlein zan huel quinittah amatlapaltin inpan tlalilli atle quittah nican.
help-board-view-gantt-what-it-is-descrip: Gantt itlachializhuan quintlahcuiloa in huapalli iamatlapalhuan ipan tonalamatl inic tiquittaz tlein pehua, tlein tlami ihuan tlein mopachoa. Gantt ce tlatecpantli ica ce tecpantli ica cecen amatlapalli ihuan ce machiyotl ica cecen itonal, auh Frappe Gantt ihuan DHTMLX Gantt quintlahcuiloa cecen amatlapalli iuhqui ce mecatl itzinpehualizpa ixquich itlamiliz.
help-board-view-gantt-how-it-works-descr: Xicpepena Gantt, Frappe Gantt noso DHTMLX Gantt ipan Tonalamatl ihuan cahuitl itlacentlaliliz ipan Huapalli itlachializ itlaahxitiliz; in amatlapaltin monequi quipiazqueh ce tonalli tlein oquicelih, itzinpehualiz, itlamiliztonal noso itlamiliz. Ipan Gantt, cecen chicomeilhuitl ica tonaltin quipia itlatecpan; xicpachoa ce amatlapalli itocaitl inic ticpohuaz noso ce tonalli imachiyo inic ticpatlaz inon tonalli. Ipan Frappe Gantt ihuan DHTMLX Gantt, in tlacameh tlein huel tlahcuiloah huel quihuilanazqueh ce mecatl inic quipatlazqueh in amatlapalli icahuiuh.
help-board-view-product-backlog-what-it-: Tlanamactli Itequiuh Mocahua yehhuatl in tecpantli tocatlahtolli ica tequitl tlein ce Scrum tequihuahcayotl ayamo quicui ipan ce tequicahuitl (Sprint). Quinextia in huapalli iamatlapalhuan tlein ahmo quipiah axcan tequicahuitl, tecpantin ica itlatlaliliz, ahmo quinquixtia intocatlahtolhuan.
help-board-view-product-backlog-how-it-w: Xicnamiqui ce amatlapalli ipan tlatecpantli ihuan, ipan itlachihualiz caxitl, xictlali iTequicahuiuh, itlatlaliliz ipan Tequitl Mocahua, iTlaquixtiliz, itequiuh itlamantiliz ihuan itlaceliliz tlanahuatilli, niman xicpachoa Xicpiya. In tepitoton tlapohualli achtopa huitzeh. Xicpachilti Ctrl, noso Cmd ipan Mac, inic ticalaquiz ce amatlapalli ipan miec tlaquixtiliztli. Xicpachoa ce amatlapalli itzontecon inic ticpohuaz, ihuan Xiquitta occequi inic tiquinaxitiz oc 100 amatlapaltin. In patlaliztli quitoca in amatlapalli itlahuelitiliz.
help-board-view-sprints-what-it-is-descr: Ce tequicahuitl (Sprint) ce tepiton, tlatlalilli cahuitl ipan ce Scrum tequihuahcayotl quitlamia ce tequitl tlapepenalli ica ce tlanequiliztli. Tequicahuitl itlachializ oncan in huapalli itequicahuiuh motlaliah, pehuah, motzacuah noso mopolohuah, ihuan itlaquixtiliz ihuan Scrum ilhuihuan.
help-board-view-sprints-how-it-works-des: Ce huapalli tepachoani achtopa quitlapohua Scrum itlaahxitiliz, quitlaxotla Scrum itlatlaliliz ihuan quipepena in tlatlaliliztli ihuitzyan, itlapohual, itlamiliz nahuatilli ihuan tequitl tonaltin. Niman xicchihua ce tequicahuitl ica tocaitl, tlanequiliztli, itzinpehualiz ihuan itlamiliz, xiquintlali amatlapaltin ipan ica Tlanamactli Itequiuh Mocahua, ihuan xicpachoa Xicpehualti tequicahuitl. Inic ticneltiliz, xicpepena campa yauh in tequitl ahmo tlantoc ihuan xicpachoa Xictzacua tequicahuitl, noso xicmaca ce tlein ipampa ihuan xicpachoa Xicpolo tequicahuitl. Zan huapalli tepachoanimeh quinyecanah in tequicahuitl.
help-board-view-sprint-report-what-it-is: Ce tequicahuitl itlapohualamauh quitoa tlein omochiuh ipan ce tequicahuitl tlatzacualli: tlein omotenehuac, tlein otlanqui, tlein omaquitih, tlein omoquixtih ihuan tlein ahmo otlanqui. Iciyahuacayo quintecpana inin tlamantli ica mochintin tequicahuitl tlatzacualli, inic in occe tequicahuitl motlaliz ica tlein melahuac oquichiuh in tequihuahcayotl.
help-board-view-sprint-report-how-it-wor: Ipan Tequicahuitl Itlapohualamauh, xicpepena ce tequicahuitl ihuan xicpepena Amatlapaltin noso Tlatlaliliztli icpac in mecatl, niman xicpohua in tonalli itequiuh ihuan tlein mocahua ihuan in tlahtollotl ica cecen patlaliztli itlan. Ipan Iciyahuacayo, xicpohua ce tecpantli ica cecen tequicahuitl tlatzacualli. In tlamantli huitzeh ipan ixiptlatl tlein omocuic ihcuac cecen tequicahuitl opeuh ihuan omotzacuh, inic in patlaliztli zatepan amo quipatlah. Xicquixti quipiya in tlamantli iuhqui PDF noso Excel, ihuan Occeppa xicaxiti quiyancuilia in tlapohualamatl.
help-board-view-burndown-what-it-is-desc: Inin Scrum tlacuilolli quinextiah quenin yauh in tequitl ica cahuitl. Burndown quinextia quezqui tequitl mocahua tonalli ica tonalli auh Burnup quezqui otlanqui, Iciyahuacayo quinextia quezqui oquitlamih cecen tequicahuitl tlatzacualli, Tlaquixtiliztli Burndown quitoca in tequitl tlein mocahua ipan ce tlaquixtiliztli, auh Epic Iyaliz quinextia quexquich oyahqueh in amatlapaltin tetahhuan.
help-board-view-burndown-how-it-works-de: Xicpepena in tlacuilolli itlan Scrum ipan Huapalli itlachializ itlaahxitiliz. Cecen tlacuilolli quitlahcuiloa ica in huapalli iamatlapalhuan ihuan itequicahuiuh ihuan quinextia in tlapohualli ipan ce tlatecpantli itlan in tlacuilolli. Iciyahuacayo quinequi ceppa ce tequicahuitl tlatzacualli, ihuan mitzcahuilia ticpepenaz Amatlapaltin noso Tlatlaliliztli. Xicpachoa Xicquixti ipan tlacpac inic tiquinpiyaz in yehhuan tlapohualli iuhqui PDF noso Excel. Ce tlacuilolli tlein ayamo quipia tlein quitlahcuiloz quitoa Atle tlanextilli.
help-board-view-roadmap-what-it-is-descr: Ohtlatecpantli quincentlalia amatlapaltin ipan tecpantli ica ce monemac tlalli itlamach, iuhqui ce tlaquixtiliztli noso ce huei tequitl, ihuan quintlahcuiloa cecen tecpantli iamatlapalhuan ipan ce tonalli ohtli. Cualli ica ce tlaquixtiliztli noso tlamantli itlatecpan ihcuac inon centlaliliztli ye mopia ipan ce monemac tlalli.
help-board-view-roadmap-how-it-works-des: In huapalli quinequi ceppa ce monemac tlalli ica tlahcuilolli noso tlapepenaliztli. Xicpepena in tlalli ipan Xiquincentlali ica ipan tlacpac; cecen tlamach quipia itepiton Gantt tlacuilol ica iamatlapalhuan, auh in amatlapaltin ahmo tlamach mocentlaliah itlan Ahmo tlamach. In amatlapaltin motlaliah ica intonalhuan, xiquinmaca itzinpehualiz ihuan itlamiliztonal inic tiquinittaz ipan tonalli ohtli.
help-board-view-dashboard-what-it-is-des: Inin Ixtlachializtli tlacuilolli quinanquiliah quexquich tequitl quipia in huapalli ihuan quenin moxexeloa itequiuh: Ixtlachiyaloni ihuan Iyollo quitlahtolcentlaliah in huapalli, Tequiyetiliztli quinextia aquin tlein quipia, Tlaxexeloliztli quenin moxexeloah in amatlapaltin, Tlatzacuiliztli Itlalamauh quenin amatlapaltin motzacuiliah noso monetechpachoah, ihuan Tequitl Itotoniliz ihcuac tlacameh tequitih ipan huapalli.
help-board-view-dashboard-how-it-works-d: Xicpepena ce tlacuilolli ipan Ixtlachializtli itlacentlaliliz ipan Huapalli itlachializ itlaahxitiliz. Cecen amatl quitlahcuiloa in tlacuilolli ica huapalli iamatlapalhuan ihuan itlahtollo ihuan quinextia in tlatecpantli ica tlapohualli itlan. Xicpachoa Xicquixti ipan tlacpac inic ticpiyaz inon tlamantli iuhqui PDF noso Excel. Ihcuac ayamo onca tlein motlahcuiloz, in tlacuilolli quitoa Atle tlanextilli.
help-board-view-bigboard-what-it-is-desc: Huei Huapalli quinpepechoa mochintin huapaltin ipan titlacatl ipan ce amatl tlein huel motlaltoca, cecen ica itocatlahtolhuan ihuan iamatlapalhuan, inic huel titequitiz ipan mochintin mohuapalhuan zan ceppa.
help-board-view-bigboard-how-it-works-de: Xictlapo Huei Huapalli ipan Huapalli itlachializ itlaahxitiliz ihuan xicchiya ixquich moaxitiah cecen huapalli iamatlapalhuan. Cecen huapalli itlaxexelol tequiti iuhqui ce huapalli: xiquinhuilana amatlapaltin inic tocatlahtoltin, xiquintlapo amatlapaltin ihuan xiquinpatla tocatlahtoltin. No huel ticuilanaz ce amatlapalli ipan ce occe huapalli itocatlahtol ipan inin amatl, tlein quizaca ipan inon huapalli. In tocatlahtoltin zan huel mohuilanah ipan inhuapal. Xicpachoa ce huapalli itzontecon inic ticpohuaz zan iselti.
help-board-view-flow-what-it-is-descript: Kanban Iyaliz itlacuilolhuan quinextiah quenin mozacatiuh in tequitl ipan huapalli: tlacentlalilli iyaliz, tlayecaniliztli ihuan cecen ohtli icahuiuh, tlatlaniliztli ixquich tlantoc, iyaliz icualtiliz, tlein quiza, tequitl tlein ipan mochihua, huehuetqui tequitl, tlatzacuiliztli, tlachializtli ihcuac tlamiz in tequitl, tlachihualiztli ineltiliz ihuan intla in huehueyi tlatlaliliztli oc huecahuah. Mitzpalehuiah inic ticnamiquiz campa motecpichoa in tequitl ihuan quexquich cahuitl melahuac quitequitiltia.
help-board-view-flow-how-it-works-descri: Xicpepena ce tlacuilolli ipan Kanban iyaliz itlacentlaliliz ipan Huapalli itlachializ itlaahxitiliz. Xicpohua in tlahtolli itlan itzontecon, tlein quitoa quenin tlatamachihua, niman in tlacuilolli ihuan in tlatecpantli itlan. Cequin amatl quipiah tlaahxitiliztli, iuhqui amatlapaltin tlanequililli ihuan tonalli ica Monte Carlo Tlachializtli noso in huehuetiliz tlalli ica Tequitl Ihuehuetiliz ihuan Cecen Ohtli Icahuiuh, tlein motequitiltiah ica Xictequiti. Xicquixti ipan tlacpac quinpiya in tlatecpantli iuhqui PDF noso Excel.
help-board-view-reports-what-it-is-descr: Inin tlapohualamatl quinextiah quenin mozacatiuh in tequitl ipan huapalli chicomeilhuitl ica chicomeilhuitl: amatlapaltin omochiuhqueh ihuan otlanqueh, iyaliz tlamelahualli, quexquich cahuitl mocahuah amatlapaltin ipan cecen tocatlahtolli, amatlapaltin tlapohtoqueh ixiuhyo, cecen chicomeilhuitl itlaquixtiliz ihuan quezquipa monamiquih in tlamiliztonaltin.
help-board-view-reports-how-it-works-des: Xicpepena ce tlapohualamatl ipan Kanban iyaliz itlacentlaliliz ipan Huapalli itlachializ itlaahxitiliz: Omochiuhqueh ihuan Otlanqueh, Iyaliz Tlamelahualli, Cahuitl ipan Tocatlahtolli, Ixiuhyo, Tlaquixtiliztli Itlacuilol noso Tlamiliztonalli Ineltiliz. Cecen quinextia ce tlacuilolli ihuan, itlan, in tlatecpantli ica tlapohualli tlein ica motlahcuiloa. Xicpachoa Xicquixti ipan tlacpac inic ticpiyaz inon tlatecpantli iuhqui PDF noso Excel.
help-board-view-map-what-it-is-descripti: Tlalamatl itlachializ quinextia in huapalli iamatlapalhuan iuhqui machiyotl ipan ce ixiptlatl tlein quitlalia in huapalli tepachoani, iuhqui ce calli itlalamauh noso ce altepetl itlalamauh. Cualli ica tequitl tlein mochihua ipan tlaltin, iuhqui calli, tepoztli noso milli.
help-board-view-map-how-it-works-descrip: Ce huapalli tepachoani quipachoa Xictlali ce tlalamatl ixiptla ihuan quipepena ce PNG, JPEG, GIF noso WebP amatl, ihuan zatepan huel quiquixtiz ahmo quipolozqueh in amatlapaltin intlal. In tlacameh tlein huel quipatlah in huapalli quinittah in amatlapaltin ayamo ipan tlalamatl; xicuilana ce ipan ixiptlatl, noso xicpepena ihuan xicpachoa campa itech pohui, ihuan xicuilana ce machiyotl inic ticzacaz. Ce machiyotl quicui in amatlapalli iachtopa imachio itlapal, ihuan ihcuac ticpachoa quitlapohua in amatlapalli.
help-board-view-email-what-it-is-descrip: Tlahcuilolli itlachializ quinextia in huapalli iuhqui ce tlahcuilolcaxitl: in amatlapaltin yehhuantin in tlanonotzaliztli, in tocatlahtoltin yehhuantin in amapepechtli ihuan in machiotl yehhuantin in machiotl. Huel tictlahcuiloz ihuan ticnanquiliz tlahcuilolli ica huapalli ichan itoca, inic in nanquiliztli mocuepah ipan huapalli iuhqui amatlapaltin ihuan tlahtolpehualiztin.
help-board-view-email-how-it-works-descr: Xicpachoa Tlacelilli, Tlatitlantli, Mochi tlahcuilolli, ce tocatlahtolli noso ce machiotl inic ticpepenaz tlein monextia, xictlahcuilo ipan tlatemoliztli inic tiquintepitzinoaz in tecpantli, ihuan xicpachoa ce tecpantli inic ticpohuaz in amatlapalli, ipan itlahtolpehualizhuan yehhuatl in nonotzaliztli. Xictlahcuilo quichihua yancuic tlahcuilolli auh in nanquiliztli machiyotl quinanquilia ce, titlantli ica huapalli ichan itoca. In huapalli achtopa monequi quiceliz tlahcuilolli, tlaxotlalli ipan huapalli Itlanahuatil Itlaahxitiliz itlan Tlahcuilolli ihuicpa amatlapalli.
help-board-view-chat-what-it-is-descript: Nonotzaliztli itlachializ quinextia in huapalli iuhqui ce nonotzaloyan: cecen amatlapalli ica nonotzaliztli ce ohtli ihuan itlahtolpehualizhuan yehhuantin in tlanonotzaliztli. In ohtin icuauhyo quitlapachoa mochintin huapaltin tlein huel tiquittaz, ica in tlapohualli tlanonotzaliztli ayamo otiquinpouh.
help-board-view-chat-how-it-works-descri: Xictlapo ce tequitiloyan ihuan ce huapalli ipan Ohtin ihuan xicpachoa ce amatlapalli; motlapohua ipan tlanepantla ihuan itlanonotzalizhuan ipan nonotzaliztli itlal. Xictlahcuilo ce tlanonotzaliztli ihuan xicpachoa Enter noso Xictitlani; Shift+Enter quipehualtia yancuic pantli. Inic ticpehualtiz nonotzaliztli ipan ce amatlapalli ahmo tlanonotzaliztli, xicpachoa Xiquinitta mochintin amatlapaltin ica inon huapalli ihuan xicpepena in amatlapalli. In tlaltin mocuepah ica tlahtolli tlein motlahcuiloa iyecmapa ihuan iopochpa.
help-board-view-version-control-what-it-: Tlapatlaliztli Itlayecanaliz itlachializ quinextia in huapalli iuhqui ce tlahcuilolpiyaloyan itlaihiyohuiliz tlapohualiz: in amatlapaltin yehhuantin in tlaihiyohuiliztli, in machiotl yehhuantin in machiotl, in machiotl ica tlamiliztonalli yehhuantin in tlatlaliliztli, in tlahtolpehualiztin yehhuantin in nonotzaliztli ihuan in tlanamictilli yehhuantin in amatl. No quincalaquia ihuan quinnamiquiltia tlaihiyohuiliztli ipan GitHub, GitLab, Gitea ihuan Forgejo.
help-board-view-version-control-how-it-w: Xiquinitta in tlaihiyohuiliztli tlapohtoqueh ihuan tlatzacualtin, xiquintlaixpehpena ica machiotl noso tlatlaliliztli, ihuan xictlapo ce tlaihiyohuiliztli inic ticpohuaz ihuan ticaquitiz itlahtol. Ce amatlapalli mopohua tlatzacualli ihcuac ca pixcalco noso ipan ce tocatlahtolli iuhqui Tlatzacualli noso Otlanqui. In yancuic tlaihiyohuiliztli mocuepah amatlapaltin ipan huapalli itocatlahtol tlapohtoc, auh Xictzacua noso Occeppa xictlapo quizaca in amatlapalli inic tocatlahtoltin tlapohtoc ihuan tlatzacualli. Mochi zan amatlapalli itlamach, inic in patlaliztli mopiah ipan huapalli itlahtollo.
help-board-view-column-sets-what-it-is-d: Tlaquetzalli Itlacentlaliliz mitzcahuilia tiquintecpanaz in yehhuan amatlapaltin ipan occequi tlamantli, iuhqui ica tlein achtopa, tlatlaliliztli noso huehuetiliztli, ahmo ticquixtiz ce amatlapalli itocatlahtolpa. Cecen centlaliliztli quipia itlaquetzalhuan tlapalli.
help-board-view-column-sets-how-it-works: Ce huapalli tepachoani quitlahcuiloa ce tocaitl ipan Yancuic tlaquetzalli itlacentlaliliz ihuan quipachoa Xicaquiti, niman quinaquitia tlaquetzaltin ica tocaitl ihuan tlapalli. Xicpepena ce centlaliliztli ipan tlacpac; cecen amatlapalli ca ipan ce itlaquetzal noso ipan Ahmo tlalilli. Xicuilana ce amatlapalli ipan occe tlaquetzalli inic ticpatlaz itlal zan ipan inin centlaliliztli; itocatlahtol, iohhuan, imachiohuan ihuan itlacahuan amo mopatlah. Cecen amatlapalli no quinextia tepitoton machiotl ica itlaquetzal ipan occequintin centlaliliztli.
help-board-view-website-what-it-is-descr: Tlanextiloyan itlachializ quinextia in huapalli iuhqui ce tlanextiloyan tlachihualli ica iamatlapalhuan ihuan itlanamictilhuan, iuhqui ce tlanextiloyan calaquilli ipan WordPress, Ghost, Blogger noso ce ahmo mozacani tlanextiloyan. Ce huapalli tepan huel motlapohuaz ipan inin tlachializtli, inic in tlachiyaqueh quittah in tlanextiloyan ipan huapalli ichan itoca.
help-board-view-website-how-it-works-des: In amatlapaltin ipan ce tocatlahtolli itoca Tlanextilli onoqueh ipan tlanextiloyan, noso mochintin tocatlahtoltin iamatlapalhuan ihcuac ahmo onca inon tocatlahtolli; in amatlapaltin pixcalco nima amo monextiah. In amatlapaltin ipan ce ohtli itoca Amatl quichihuah in tlaahxitiliztli, ica tequitontin iuhqui amatontli, auh in occequintin amatlapaltin yehhuantin tlanonotzaliztli ipan iachtopa amatl, in yancuictin achtopa. Ce amatlapalli itlahtol yehhuatl in amatl itlahcuilol ihuan itlanamictilhuan yehhuantin ixiptlahuan ihuan iamauh. Inic ticchihuaz ce huapalli tepan itlachializ, xicpepena ipan Huapalli itlaahxitiliz / Huapalli itlachializ.
help-board-view-shop-what-it-is-descript: Tlanamacoyan itlachializ quinextia in tlanamactli ipan huapalli iamatlapalhuan iuhqui ce tlanamacoyan, ica ixiptlatl, ipatiuh, itlamantiliz, ce tlanamactli iamauh, ce chiquihuitl ihuan ce tlaxtlahuiliztli. Ce amatlapalli ipan ce tocatlahtolli tlanamacalli mocuepa tlanamactli ihcuac ipatiuh itlal quipia ce tlapohualli, ihuan imachiohuan mocuepah itlamantiliz.
help-board-view-shop-how-it-works-descri: Ce huapalli tepachoani quitlalia in tlanamacoyan ipan Huapalli itlaahxitiliz / Tlanamacoyan: in ipatiuh, tlanamactli itlapohual ihuan tlein mopia itlal, ce ichtacayo Tlacohualiztli tocatlahtolli, in tomin, VAT, tlaxtlahuiliztli itlamantiliz, in tocatlahtoltin tlanamacalli ihuan in machiotl tlein monextiah iuhqui tlamantiliztli, niman quimachiyotia Tlanamacoyan tlapohtoc. In tlacohuanimeh tlaixpehpenah ica tlamantiliztli, quinaquitiah tlanamactli ipan chiquihuitl ihuan tlaxtlahuah.
